items.title: 川普稱美國可能留在伊朗「保留石油」！伊朗戰爭料「年底前」結束
items.title_en: Trump Says the U.S. Might Remain in Iran and "Retain Oil"! Iran War Expected to End "Before Year‑End"
paras: 美國總統川普週日（13日）表示，美國可能留在伊朗並「保留石油」，並將此與美國推動掌控委內瑞拉龐大石油儲量五分之一的行動相提並論。
根據《路透》報導，川普在前往愛爾蘭參加會議並觀看高爾夫賽事期間重申，他仍預期伊朗戰爭將在今年結束，時間可能就在11月美國期中選舉結束後不久。
川普在愛爾蘭公開賽高爾夫錦標賽期間表示，一旦伊朗戰爭結束，汽油價格將「像石頭一樣暴跌」。
中東局勢動盪已持續衝擊國際原油市場。沙烏地阿拉伯一條輸油管線遭到攻擊後，原油交易商預期油價週一可能再次走高。
川普表示，美國只會達成「正確的協議」，不會接受「不好的協議」。他並稱伊朗「一直在打電話」要求進行和平談判，但德黑蘭過去曾否認這項說法。
不過，川普同時提出另一種可能性，即美國繼續與伊朗保持接觸，並指出美國8月宣布的委內瑞拉協議作為對照。
川普表示：「我們最終會離開伊朗，除非我們決定留下來，像委內瑞拉一樣保留石油。」他並補充，美國從委內瑞拉取得的收入「已經多次支付戰爭的成本」。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Sunday (the 13th) that the United States might stay in Iran and "retain oil," likening this to the U.S. push to control one‑fifth of Venezuela’s massive oil reserves.

According to Reuters, Trump reiterated during a trip to Ireland for a conference and a golf tournament that he still expects the war with Iran to end this year, possibly shortly after the U.S. mid‑term elections in November.
Speaking at the Irish Open golf championship, Trump said that once the Iran war is over, gasoline prices will "plummet like a stone."
Turbulence in the Middle East has continued to weigh on the global crude market. After a Saudi Arabian oil pipeline was attacked, oil traders expected prices could rise again on Monday.
Trump said the United States will only strike a "right agreement" and will not accept a "bad agreement." He added that Iran has "kept calling" for peace talks, a claim Tehran has previously denied.
However, Trump also floated another possibility—that the United States could keep engaging with Iran—and pointed to the Venezuela deal announced by the U.S. in August as a comparison.

Trump said, "We will eventually leave Iran unless we decide to stay, retaining oil like we did in Venezuela," and added that the revenue the U.S. has taken from Venezuela "has already paid for the war many times over."

items.title: AI行為準則今公布！微軟執行長納德拉：支持AI審慎發展與嵌入式評估機制
items.title_en: AI Code of Conduct Unveiled Today! Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella: Supports Prudent AI Development and Embedded Evaluation Mechanisms
paras: 微軟執行長納德拉週(13)日在X平台上發文談及微軟的先進AI發展理念，認為任何對超級智慧的探索都必須在核心原則約束下運作。如果人們建構的AI無法幫助人類，無法被人類控制，就不值得發展。
但他認為，AI需要加速發展，使其成果能廣泛傳播，並惠及不同國家、社區和企業。這顯然需要建立前沿生態，讓開源和閉源模型都能蓬勃發展。對企業來說，這意味著他們必須完全掌握自身獨有的隱性知識。每家公司都應該可以建構屬於自己的、持續學習循環、不斷迭代的系統，而不必依賴單一模型供應商，還應將自身知識融入模型中。
在此背景下，納德拉表示，他歡迎必要的研究、關注和有意識的推進節奏，以確保「對齊」成為設計目標。
他也歡迎「嵌入式評估器」等概念，以及更廣泛的努力，推動建立相關機制，讓這些理念不只是停留在口語層面。
納德拉還強調，這一領域不能由少數幾個實體控制，必須讓整個生態系統、不同國家和各個領域，包括學術界，都廣泛參與其中。
他同時表示，微軟的方案是在AI技術堆疊的每一層提供廣泛存取權限與選擇，以及支撐微軟自研MAI模型的《行為準則》。該準則將於週一(13日)發布，公開徵求意見。
paras_en: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella posted on X on Tuesday (the 13th) about the company’s advanced AI development philosophy, stating that any exploration of superintelligence must operate under core principles. If the AI we build cannot help humanity or be controlled by humans, it is not worth developing.

He added that AI needs to accelerate so its benefits can be widely disseminated and reach different countries, communities and businesses. This clearly requires building a frontier ecosystem where both open‑source and closed‑source models can thrive. For enterprises, this means they must fully own their proprietary tacit knowledge. Each company should be able to build its own continuously learning, iterating system without relying on a single model vendor, and embed its own knowledge into the models.
In this context, Nadella said he welcomes necessary research, attention and a conscious pace of progress to ensure that “alignment” becomes a design goal.
He also welcomed concepts such as “embedded evaluators” and broader efforts to establish mechanisms that move these ideas beyond mere rhetoric.
Nadella emphasized that this field must not be controlled by a few entities; the entire ecosystem, different nations and sectors—including academia—must be broadly involved.

He added that Microsoft’s approach is to provide broad access and choice at every layer of the AI technology stack, and to support Microsoft’s internally developed MAI model with a “Code of Conduct.” The code will be released on Monday the 13th for public comment.

items.title: 金管會最新人事 周正山接任金融市場發展及創新處處長
items.title_en: Financial Supervisory Commission Announces Latest Personnel Change: Zhou Zhengshan Appointed Director of Financial Market Development and Innovation Division
paras: 金管會今(14)日宣布最新人事異動，金融市場發展及創新處處長一職，由原銀行局主任秘書周正山調陞；原創新處處長林羲聖則派任金管會參事。本項人事案已於2026年9月7日經行政院核定，並於今日正式到任生效。
金管會表示，新任創新處處長周正山學經歷相當完整，畢業於國立政治大學公共行政學系，並取得國立政治大學公共行政學系及國立臺灣大學經濟學系雙碩士學位。考選資格方面，於民國84年通過公務人員高等考試二等考試人事行政類科及格。
周正山處長深耕金融監理與管理體系多年，歷任金管會科長、金管會銀行局專門委員、副組長、組長及主任秘書等要職。憑藉其在銀行監理、法規與經濟政策上的紮實專業背景，未來可望帶領創新處持續推動金融科技發展、市場創新應用及金融產業競爭力之提升。
paras_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission announced today (the 14th) its latest personnel changes: the position of Director of the Financial Market Development and Innovation Division will be filled by Zhou Zhengshan, formerly the Secretary-General of the Banking Bureau; the former Director of the Innovation Division, Lin Xi-sheng, will be appointed as a consultant to the Commission. This personnel decision was approved by the Executive Yuan on September 7, 2026, and takes effect today.

The Commission noted that the newly appointed Director of the Innovation Division, Zhou Zhengshan, has a comprehensive academic background, having graduated from the Department of Public Administration at National Chengchi University and earned dual master’s degrees from National Chengchi University’s Public Administration program and the Department of Economics at National Taiwan University. He passed the second‑level civil service examination in the personnel administration category in 1995 (the 84th year of the Republic of China).

Director Zhou Zhengshan has spent many years deepening his expertise in financial supervision and management systems, having served in senior roles such as Section Chief at the Commission, specialist commissioner, deputy division chief, division chief, and Secretary‑General of the Banking Bureau. Leveraging his solid professional background in bank supervision, regulations, and economic policy, he is expected to lead the Innovation Division in continuing to promote fintech development, market‑innovation applications, and the enhancement of the financial industry’s competitiveness.

items.title: 高CP值國宅仍是熱門交易社區  成功等7大國宅撐起熱銷榜半邊天
items.title_en: High Cost‑Performance Public Housing Remains a Popular Trading Community; Chenggong and Seven Other Public Housing Projects Support Half of the Hot‑Sale Rankings
paras: 房仲業者依內政部實價登錄資料，盤點近一年台北市十大熱銷社區。數據顯示，萬華區「台北晶麒」累計成交34戶奪冠；國宅社區則憑藉地段機能與價格優勢，一舉攻佔7個席位。此外，多數上榜社區房價低於所屬行政區平均行情，顯見相對實惠的價格成為購屋族入主該區域的替代選擇。
針對再度蟬聯熱銷交易冠軍「台北晶麒」。永慶房屋研展中心副理陳金萍表示，該社區位於龍山寺生活圈，周邊商圈發展成熟，且屋齡約10年，在老屋林立的萬華區中格外稀缺。雖然近一年「台北晶麒」平均單價76.6萬元，每坪較行政區均價高出8萬元，但因產品規劃多為中小坪數，總價門檻相對容易負擔；對購屋族而言，不僅能免去老屋翻修的隱形成本，又能享有飯店式管理與完善公設，因此深受小資族群青睞，買氣持續穩健。
台北市十大熱銷社區榜單中，高性價比的「國宅」依舊是市場焦點，共有7個國宅社區上榜。陳金萍指出，國宅具備公設比低、實際使用空間大的特點，且多座落於開發成熟、交通便利的核心地段，加上價格普遍較所在行政區親民，因此在市場上流通性極高。

進一步觀察，大安區與萬華區並列最熱銷行政區，各有3個社區上榜，且大安區上榜的「成功國宅」、「大安國宅」與「郵政新村」都是國宅。其中排名第二的「成功國宅」近一年成交量24件，平均單價為86萬元，與行政區整體均價113.8萬元相比，每坪可省下27.8萬元，是榜單中價差最大的社區。陳金萍說明，成功國宅坐落於捷運科技大樓站周邊，生活機能優異，並擁有國北教大實小、大安國中等明星學區光環。對於預算有限、但想卡位黃金門牌與優質教育資源的家庭而言，相當具有吸引力。
另一亮點是中山區的「春暉新世界」，平均總價僅821萬元，是榜上唯一總價「千萬元有找」的社區。陳金萍說，該社區鄰近捷運中山國小站，交通與生活機能極佳，以小坪數的套房產品為主，超低總價吸引預算有限的首購與通勤族買盤。不過「春暉新世界」屬於住商混合型社區，戶數規模大，且屋齡超過40年，購屋前需將住戶出入複雜、公設維護不易等特性納入考量。
整體而言，陳金萍補充，台北市十大熱銷社區可提供民眾購屋時參考，通常具備較佳的市場接受度及流通性。不過，熱銷不等於可以滿足所有購屋族需求，建議民眾仍應進一步比較屋齡、社區修繕、管理品質、土地持分與個別樓層條件，並依自身財務能力審慎評估。
paras_en: According to the Ministry of the Interior’s real‑price registration data, real‑estate agents compiled a list of the top ten hottest communities in Taipei over the past year. The data show that the “Taipei Jingqi” community in Wanhua District led the list with 34 transactions, while public‑housing communities captured seven of the ten spots thanks to their location advantages and lower prices. Moreover, most of the listed communities have unit prices below the average for their respective districts, indicating that relatively affordable pricing has become an alternative choice for homebuyers entering these areas.

Regarding the repeat champion “Taipei Jingqi,” Chen Jin‑ping, deputy manager of the Yong‑qing Real Estate Research Center, said the community is located in the Longshan Temple lifestyle circle, surrounded by a mature commercial district, and the buildings are about ten years old, making them especially scarce among the many older structures in Wanhua. Although its average price over the past year was NT$7.66 million per ping—about NT$800,000 higher than the district average—the projects mainly consist of small‑to‑medium units, keeping the total price threshold relatively affordable. For buyers, this means avoiding the hidden costs of renovating older homes while enjoying hotel‑style management and comprehensive public facilities, which has made the community especially popular with young professionals and its sales momentum remains steady.

In the top‑ten list of Taipei’s hottest communities, high‑value‑for‑money public housing remains a market focus, with seven public‑housing estates making the list. Chen noted that public housing features low common‑area ratios and larger usable spaces, and most are situated in well‑developed, transit‑convenient core locations. Coupled with prices that are generally more affordable than the surrounding district averages, these factors give public housing very high market liquidity.

A closer look shows that Da’an District and Wanhua District tie for the hottest administrative districts, each contributing three communities to the list. In Da’an, the “Chenggong Public Housing,” “Da’an Public Housing,” and “Postal New Village” are all public‑housing projects. The second‑ranked “Chenggong Public Housing” recorded 24 transactions in the past year with an average price of NT$8.6 million per ping, saving NT$2.78 million per ping compared with the district’s overall average of NT$11.38 million—the largest price gap on the list. Chen explained that Chenggong is located near the Technology Building MRT station, boasts excellent living amenities, and is surrounded by prestigious school zones such as the National Taiwan University of Science and Technology elementary school and Da’an Junior High. For families with limited budgets who still want a prime address and quality education resources, it is particularly attractive.

Another highlight is the “Chunhui New World” in Zhongshan District, whose average total price is only NT$8.21 million, making it the only community on the list with a total price under ten million. Chen said the development is close to the Zhongshan Elementary School MRT station, offering excellent transportation and lifestyle convenience, and mainly offers small‑size studio units, whose ultra‑low total price appeals to first‑time buyers and commuters with limited budgets. However, Chunhui New World is a mixed‑use residential‑commercial community with a large number of units and a building age exceeding 40 years, so prospective buyers should consider the complexity of resident traffic and the difficulty of maintaining common areas.

Overall, Chen added that Taipei’s top‑ten hottest communities can serve as a reference for homebuyers because they generally enjoy better market acceptance and liquidity. Nevertheless, hot‑selling status does not guarantee that a community meets every buyer’s needs; she advises buyers to further compare building age, community repairs, management quality, land‑share ratios, and individual floor conditions, and to assess these factors carefully against their own financial capabilities.

items.title: 外資單月狂買3568億創新高！AI浪潮發威 法人看好今年台股獲利成長逾4成
items.title_en: Foreign Investors Set Record Monthly Purchase of NT$356.8 Billion! AI Wave Fuels Gains, Institutions Expect Over 40% Profit Growth for Taiwan Stocks This Year
paras: 受惠於AI投資需求暢旺與科技供應鏈持續擴張，帶動今年來台股漲幅在亞洲主要市場中名列前茅。柏瑞投信表示，儘管仍有美國聯準會利率政策走向、通膨及國際油價走揚等不確定因素，使得台股仍有短線高檔震盪的機率，但在經濟基本面穩健和企業獲利增長強勁的支撐下，預期2026年台股獲利成長率達40%以上，多頭格局並未改變，加上外資單月狂買3568億元創新高，AI供應鏈接棒，讓台股續攻有底氣。
柏瑞投信指出，在歷經前波修正後，台股8月展開強勁反彈，外資單月買超達3568億元，創歷史單月新高，成為推升本周行情的重要資金動能。整體而言，台股AI主線依然明確，盤勢已由去槓桿修正轉向外資回流與獲利預期修復。
此外，台股此波的反彈除了來自資金回流，基本面亦提供支撐。台灣7月出口達753億美元、年增32%，AI伺服器、半導體及資通產品仍是主要成長來源；更具領先意義的外銷訂單亦創歷史新高，其中資訊通信與電子產品的接單分別年增89.5%及71.7%，顯示全球AI資本支出正持續轉化為台灣科技供應鏈的實質需求。
柏瑞投信投資策略部副總經理鄭筑文表示，觀察台股企業獲利上修趨勢自2025年下半年以來延續至今，尚未出現反轉訊號。市場預期台股2026年獲利成長率達40以上，由此推估台股評價面仍合理，成為台股多頭格局的重要支撐。其中，又以科技相關次產業的獲利動能最強，顯示AI投資浪潮對台灣產業基本面的支撐力道仍強，亦已成為台股中長期的重要成長動能。
鄭筑文進一步指出，儘管市場不時質疑AI是否存在泡沫風險，但4大雲端供應商仍持續加碼資本支出，根據外資券商Morgan Stanley在5月底的統計，這4大供應商的2026年資本支出規模合計將近7400億美元，2027年更將超越1兆美元。主要業者至今未見縮減投資跡象，反映出AI需求仍具延續性，產業動能並未改變。
此外，AI發展已從單一應用延伸至整體基礎建設升級，帶動半導體製程、傳輸材料及資料中心3大領域同步擴張。隨著運算效能持續提升，產業對高規格產品的需求增加，推動供應鏈朝高附加價值的方向發展，為相關企業創造長期成長機會。
柏瑞巨人基金經理人高豪志表示，隨著台股行情從8月展開反彈，融資餘額亦回升至目前約新台幣5800億元，顯示市場信心逐步回溫。觀察目前整體融資水位仍低於前波7月中高點的6313億元，籌碼結構亦相對改善，但後續仍須留意融資增幅與指數表現是否維持合理節奏。當前投資環境正處於高評價與高成長並存的階段，選股的重要性將明顯高於單純押注市場整體方向。
展望後市，鄭筑文表示，台股第4季仍可能面臨高檔震盪，下一階段企業能否將訂單成長與規格升級，進一步轉化為營收、毛利率與獲利成長，將成為股價表現分化的關鍵。隨著AI基礎建設由「增加算力」走向「提升系統效率」，產業價值也由運算晶片轉向先進封裝、高階材料、高速傳輸、電源與散熱。台股投資將持續聚焦具備技術門檻、訂單能見度與定價能力，且有望透過規格升級帶動獲利上修的企業。
paras_en: Benefiting from strong AI investment demand and the continued expansion of the tech supply chain, Taiwan’s stock market has posted one of the best gains among major Asian markets this year. Baillie Gifford Investment Trust notes that despite uncertainties such as the direction of U.S. Fed rate policy, inflation and rising global oil prices, which could cause short‑term high‑level volatility, solid economic fundamentals and robust corporate earnings support an expected profit growth rate of over 40% for 2026. The bullish outlook remains unchanged, especially as foreign investors set a new monthly purchase record of NT$356.8 billion and the AI supply chain passes the baton, giving the market confidence to keep advancing.

Baillie Gifford points out that after a previous correction, the Taiwan market rebounded strongly in August, with foreign investors net‑buying NT$356.8 billion in a single month – a historic high that became a key driver of this week’s rally. Overall, the AI theme in Taiwan remains clear, and market dynamics have shifted from deleveraging corrections to foreign capital inflows and a recovery in earnings expectations.

In addition, the current rebound is not only fueled by capital returning but also supported by fundamentals. Taiwan’s July exports reached US$75.3 billion, up 32% year‑on‑year, with AI servers, semiconductors and ICT products still the main growth drivers. Export orders also hit record highs, with information‑communication and electronic product orders up 89.5% and 71.7% respectively, showing that global AI capex is translating into real demand for Taiwan’s tech supply chain.

Zheng Zhu‑wen, deputy head of Baillie Gifford’s investment strategy unit, said the upward revision trend in corporate earnings that began in the second half of 2025 has continued without any reversal signals. The market expects a profit growth rate above 40% for 2026, implying that valuations remain reasonable and underpin the bullish stance. Among sub‑sectors, technology‑related industries show the strongest earnings momentum, indicating that the AI investment wave still strongly supports Taiwan’s industrial fundamentals and has become a key medium‑ to long‑term growth engine for the market.

Zheng added that although some question whether AI carries a bubble risk, the four major cloud providers are still ramping up capital spending. According to Morgan Stanley’s late‑May data, the combined 2026 capex of these four providers will approach US$740 billion, exceeding US$1 trillion in 2027. The main players have shown no sign of cutting back, reflecting the persistence of AI demand and unchanged industry momentum.

Furthermore, AI development has moved beyond single applications to a broader infrastructure upgrade, driving simultaneous expansion in three areas: semiconductor processes, transmission materials and data‑center equipment. As computing power continues to rise, demand for higher‑specification products grows, pushing the supply chain toward higher‑value‑added offerings and creating long‑term growth opportunities for related companies.

Gao Hao‑zhi, portfolio manager of Baillie Gifford’s Giant Fund, said that as the market rallied from August, margin financing balances rose to about NT$580 billion, indicating a gradual recovery in market confidence. While the current financing level remains below the July mid‑high of NT$6.313 billion and the chip structure has improved, attention must still be paid to whether financing growth and index performance stay in a reasonable rhythm. The present investment environment features both high valuations and high growth, making stock selection far more important than simply betting on the market direction.

Looking ahead, Zheng cautioned that the fourth quarter may still see high‑level volatility. The key will be whether companies can turn order growth and specification upgrades into higher revenue, margins and profits, which will drive stock‑price divergence. As AI infrastructure shifts from “adding compute power” to “enhancing system efficiency,” industry value is moving from compute chips to advanced packaging, high‑end materials, high‑speed interconnects, power and cooling. Investment focus will remain on firms with technical barriers, visible orders and pricing power that can boost earnings through specification upgrades.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉尼得科超眾第一階段水冷板量產出貨 亮燈漲停站上季線
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Nidec Super (6230‑TW) Begins Mass Production and Shipment of First‑Phase Water‑Cooling Plates, Lights Up, Hits Limit Up, Stands Above Quarterly Moving Average
paras: 尼得科超眾(6230-TW)積極布局水冷散熱，並展開相關產能的布局，第一階段在中國昆山廠生產的水冷板已經量產出貨，第二階段越南廠則預計2028年投產，預期2028年水冷營收比重可提升至5%，激勵尼得科超眾今(14)日亮燈漲停，並站上季線。
尼得科超眾今天早盤以116元跳空開高，盤中亮燈漲停鎖住116.5元，一舉收復5日線、月線以及季線，排隊委買單近200張，成交量則超過200張。不過三大法人近日並無太多著墨，上周僅買超12張。
尼得科超眾指出，目前第一階段中國昆山廠的水冷板已量產出貨，規劃第二階段將複製昆山廠經驗，預計2027年將產線導入越南河內廠，並在2028年量產，屆時可望推升水冷營收比重達5%。
尼得科超眾8月營收7.59億元，月減3.7%，年減0.86%；累計今年前8月營收62.26億元，年增6.45%。
paras_en: Nidec Super (6230‑TW) is actively deploying water‑cooling heat dissipation and expanding related capacity. The first‑phase water‑cooling plates produced at its Kunshan, China plant have entered mass production and shipment. The second phase at the Vietnam plant is planned to start production in 2028, and it is expected that by 2028 the share of water‑cooling revenue will rise to 5%, prompting Nidec Super to light up and hit limit up today (14th) and stand above the quarterly moving average.

This morning Nidec Super opened higher at NT$116 on a gap up, locked limit up at NT$116.5 during the session, recapturing the 5‑day, monthly and quarterly moving averages. The order queue had nearly 200 lots of buy orders, and trading volume exceeded 200 lots. However, the three major institutional investors have not shown much interest recently; last week they only bought a net 12 lots.

Nidec Super said that the first‑phase water‑cooling plates at its Kunshan plant in China have already been mass‑produced and shipped. It plans to replicate the Kunshan experience in the second phase, expecting to introduce the production line to its Hanoi plant in Vietnam in 2027 and commence mass production in 2028, which should lift the water‑cooling revenue share to 5%.

Nidec Super's August revenue was NT$7.59 billion, down 3.7% month‑over‑month and down 0.86% year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for the first eight months of this year was NT$62.26 billion, up 6.45% year‑over‑year.

items.title: Anthropic傳選定那斯達克上市！最快10月IPO、募資規模上看超越SpaceX
items.title_en: Anthropic Chooses Nasdaq for Listing! IPO as Early as October, Fundraising Size May Surpass SpaceX
paras: 知情人士透露，Anthropic已選定那斯達克（Nasdaq）作為潛在首次公開募股（IPO）的上市地點，若最終成行，這家Claude聊天機器人開發商的上市規模可能刷新紀錄。
根據《彭博》報導，知情人士表示，Anthropic尋求透過IPO募資的金額，可能達到或超過SpaceX(SPCX-US) 的規模，這宗IPO最快可能在10月進行。
若Anthropic在那斯達克掛牌，將是該交易所今年的又一項勝利。今年美國規模最大的4宗IPO均在那斯達克進行，其中包括SpaceX於6月創下紀錄的863億美元IPO。
數週後，SK海力士（SK Hynix Inc.）也在7月上市，募得265億美元。《Business Insider》先前已報導Anthropic選擇那斯達克的消息。
Anthropic積極籌備上市之際，人工智慧（AI）產業的快速發展與潛在風險也成為業界高層近期關注焦點。
OpenAI執行長Sam Altman、Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei及馬斯週六（12日）均表示，隨著AI技術帶來的風險升高，有必要放慢AI發展速度。
Altman接受《財富》訪問時則表示，OpenAI今年不會上市，理由與安全疑慮有關。
此外，《彭博》此前報導，Anthropic本月稍早原定敲定一筆150億美元的循環信用額度。
AI競賽升溫也帶動美國IPO市場復甦。根據《彭博》彙整數據，今年美國IPO募資總額已達1,606億美元，不包括特殊目的收購公司（SPAC）及其他金融工具，創下2021年以來單年度最高紀錄。
Anthropic本身的營收成長也十分迅速。按照目前業績表現推算，Anthropic年化營收已突破650億美元，較去年底的年化營收速度增加逾7倍。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Insiders say Anthropic has selected Nasdaq as the venue for its potential initial public offering, and if it goes ahead, the Claude chatbot developer could set a record with the size of its listing.
According to Bloomberg, sources indicate Anthropic is aiming to raise an amount through the IPO that could match or exceed SpaceX (SPCX-US), with the offering possibly occurring as early as October.
If Anthropic lists on Nasdaq, it will be another win for the exchange this year. The four largest U.S. IPOs this year were all on Nasdaq, including SpaceX's record‑breaking $86.3 billion IPO in June.
Weeks later, SK Hynix also went public in July, raising $26.5 billion. Business Insider had previously reported Anthropic's choice of Nasdaq.
As Anthropic prepares for a listing, the rapid growth and potential risks of the AI industry have become a focus for senior executives.
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and Elon Musk on Saturday (the 12th) all said that rising AI‑related risks make it necessary to slow the pace of AI development.
Altman told Fortune that OpenAI will not go public this year, citing safety concerns.
Bloomberg also reported earlier this month that Anthropic had planned to secure a $15 billion revolving credit facility.

The heated AI competition is reviving the U.S. IPO market. Bloomberg data show that total U.S. IPO proceeds this year have reached $160.6 billion, excluding SPACs and other instruments, the highest annual total since 2021.
Anthropic's revenue growth is also rapid. Based on current performance, its annualized revenue has already exceeded $65 billion, more than seven times the annualized rate at the end of last year.

items.title: 富邦媒引領電商業拓資安版圖 推動FIDO無密碼驗證機制
items.title_en: Fubon Media Leads E‑commerce Expansion into Cybersecurity, Promoting FIDO Password‑less Authentication
paras: 富邦媒(8454-TW)舉辦第三屆「momo供應商ESG學苑」，今年首度以「共築信任 資安聯防」為題，成為全台首家將資安議題納入ESG供應鏈治理的電商業者，富邦媒表示，momo持續推動供應商後台管理系統導入FIDO無密碼驗證機制，目標將資安從企業內部管理延伸至供應鏈日常作業，從制度、技術到夥伴協作同步強化數位信任與營運韌性。
富邦媒表示，ESG治理正從減碳、節能，進一步走向企業能否守住數位時代的「信任」，因此，此次momo攜手近百家供應商夥伴及產學專家，共同面對AI時代的新興風險。
隨著企業數位化程度持續提高，加上生成式AI快速普及，資安風險已不再只存在於企業內部，據世界經濟論壇《Global Cybersecurity Outlook 2026》指出，65%的大型企業將第三方和供應鏈弱點列為實現資安韌性的最大挑戰，較前一年的54%大幅攀升。
富邦媒認為，當企業與供應商之間的系統、資料與服務高度串聯，任何一個環節出現漏洞，都可能沿著供應鏈擴大影響，從營運中斷一路延伸至品牌聲譽與消費者信任，因此，對電商平台而言，資安因此不只是IT議題，更逐漸成為公司治理與永續經營的一環。
富邦媒總經理谷元宏說，momo每天串聯大量消費者、品牌與供應商夥伴，信任是平台能夠長期經營最重要的基礎。面對AI與數位商務快速發展，資安不能只靠單一企業做好，而要讓整個供應鏈一起提升防護能力，希望透過供應商ESG學苑，將新的風險、知識與實務經驗帶給合作夥伴，讓資安從企業內部管理，進一步成為供應鏈共同的治理能力。
今年momo將「資安聯防」從知識交流進一步落實到供應鏈日常作業，持續推動供應商後台管理系統導入FIDO無密碼驗證機制，以更安全的身分驗證方式，降低傳統帳號密碼可能衍生的網路釣魚、帳密外洩與冒用風險。
paras_en: Fubon Media (8454‑TW) hosted the third “momo Supplier ESG Academy,” this year debuting the theme “Building Trust Together, Cybersecurity Joint Defense.” It became the first e‑commerce operator in Taiwan to incorporate cybersecurity into ESG supply‑chain governance. Fubon Media said momo continues to implement a FIDO password‑less authentication mechanism in its supplier back‑office management system, aiming to extend cybersecurity from internal corporate management to everyday supply‑chain operations, strengthening digital trust and operational resilience through policies, technology, and partner collaboration.

Fubon Media noted that ESG governance is moving beyond carbon reduction and energy saving toward the question of whether companies can maintain “trust” in the digital age. Accordingly, momo partnered with nearly a hundred supplier partners and academia‑industry experts to jointly confront emerging AI‑era risks.

As corporate digitalization deepens and generative AI spreads rapidly, cybersecurity risks are no longer confined within company walls. The World Economic Forum’s “Global Cybersecurity Outlook 2026” reports that 65% of large enterprises now cite third‑party and supply‑chain vulnerabilities as the biggest challenge to achieving cyber resilience, up sharply from 54% the previous year.

Fubon Media believes that when systems, data, and services between enterprises and suppliers are tightly integrated, a single weak link can cascade along the supply chain, expanding impacts from operational disruptions to brand reputation and consumer trust. Thus, for e‑commerce platforms, cybersecurity is not merely an IT issue but increasingly a component of corporate governance and sustainable management.

Fubon Media General Manager Gu Yuan‑hong said momo connects vast numbers of consumers, brands, and supplier partners daily, and trust is the most essential foundation for long‑term platform operation. In the face of rapid AI and digital commerce development, cybersecurity cannot rely on a single company’s efforts; the entire supply chain must elevate its protection capabilities. Through the Supplier ESG Academy, the goal is to convey new risks, knowledge, and practical experience to partners, turning cybersecurity from internal management into a shared governance capability across the supply chain.

This year, momo will move “cybersecurity joint defense” from knowledge exchange to everyday supply‑chain practice, continuously advancing the adoption of FIDO password‑less authentication in supplier back‑office systems. The more secure identity verification reduces risks of phishing, credential leaks, and account misuse associated with traditional passwords.

items.title_en: Can Creative (3443) Keep Rising After a Historic High? If September Revenue Holds This Figure, Q3 May Exceed Expectations
paras: 2026年09月14日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ ASIC設計服務業者創意(3443-TW)盤中領先台股走強，截至上午11時23分報6,460元，上漲340元或5.56%，盤中一度升至約6,570元，改寫歷史新高。股價創高背後不只是AI ASIC題材，最新營收成長速度也已超出市場原先預期。
創意8月營收58.40億元，月增1.23%、年增111.02%，連續改寫單月新高；前八月累計營收369.54億元，年增103.84%。
優分析產業資料庫顯示，創意8月單月營收比分析師預估高出19.2%，前八月累計營收也超出預估8.1%。這代表市場接下來要關注的已經不是營收能否成長，而是實際出貨速度是否快到足以帶動全年預估再次上調。

9月營收只要守住38億元，第三季就能達標
優分析產業資料庫顯示，市場目前預估創意第三季營收為154.51億元。公司7月、8月營收合計已達116.09億元，9月只要達到38.42億元，第三季就能符合市場預期。相較8月營收58.40億元，代表9月即使月減約34%，仍可達標，第三季再次超出預估的可能性已經提高。
尤其，公司第四季還將迎接北美雲端客戶下一代ASIC及自研CPU放量，市場目前預估第四季營收約192億元，有鑑於第三季的出貨熱度，第四季也同步出現上修機會。

營收超標，EPS不一定等幅增加
不過，創意目前成長較快的是Turnkey量產業務，其毛利率低於NRE設計服務。第二季毛利率已由第一季的27.2%降至21.5%，第三季市場預估約落在19%至21.1%。
因此，若後續成長主要來自Turnkey出貨增加，可能出現營收上修、EPS調高幅度相對有限的情況；若高毛利率NRE認列同步增加，加上營收規模擴大帶動費用率下降，獲利才有更明顯的上修空間。
相較營收是否超標，接下來更值得關注的是市場是否開始調高創意的EPS預估，以及上修幅度能否追上營收成長速度。
透過優分析產業資料庫，投資人可以持續比較實際營收、單季市場共識與EPS預估變化，更快判斷股價上漲只是反映營收放量，還是獲利成長也開始超出原先預期。

paras_en: 2026-09-14 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – ASIC design service provider Creative (3443‑TW) led the Taiwan market higher during the session, trading at NT$6,460 as of 11:23 a.m., up NT$340 or 5.56%. The stock briefly rose to about NT$6,570, setting a new all‑time high. The price surge is driven not only by AI‑ASIC themes but also by a revenue growth rate that has already outpaced market expectations.

Creative posted August revenue of NT$5.84 billion, up 1.23% month‑over‑month and 111.02% year‑over‑year, breaking its own single‑month record. Cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached NT$36.954 billion, a 103.84% increase YoY.

U‑Analysis’ industry database shows Creative’s August revenue beat analyst forecasts by 19.2%, and the first‑eight‑month total exceeded estimates by 8.1%. This indicates that the market’s focus will shift from whether revenue can grow to whether shipment speed is fast enough to trigger another upward revision of the full‑year outlook.

If September revenue stays at NT$3.842 billion, the third quarter will meet expectations. U‑Analysis estimates Q3 revenue at NT$15.451 billion. The company has already generated NT$11.609 billion in July‑August, so reaching NT$3.842 billion in September would hit the consensus. Even though September would be about 34% lower than August’s NT$5.84 billion, the quarter could still be on target, raising the chance of beating forecasts.

Moreover, the company expects a surge of next‑generation ASICs and its own CPUs from North American cloud customers in Q4, with market consensus forecasting roughly NT$19.2 billion for the quarter. Given the strong Q3 shipments, there is also upside potential for a Q4 revision.

Revenue may exceed expectations, but EPS may not rise proportionally. Creative’s faster growth is coming from its turnkey mass‑production business, which carries a lower gross margin than NRE design services. Gross margin fell from 27.2% in Q1 to 21.5% in Q2, and analysts project Q3 margins around 19%‑21.1%.

Therefore, if future growth is mainly driven by higher turnkey shipments, revenue upgrades could occur with only modest EPS upgrades. A more pronounced profit lift would require simultaneous growth in high‑margin NRE work and economies of scale that lower expense ratios.
Beyond whether revenue beats forecasts, the next key issue is whether the market will start raising Creative’s EPS estimates and whether any upward revisions can keep pace with revenue growth.

聯發科(2454-TW)近期接連迎來兩項大變化：輝達砸35億美元認購聯發科海外可轉債，9月起部分晶片同步漲價5%至10%。表面是資本合作與價格調整，背後卻可能意味著聯發科正加速轉向AI ASIC。
 
8月營收雖創單月新高，但部分來自漲價前提前拉貨，終端需求是否真的轉強仍待觀察。真正的關鍵，還在AI ASIC能否放量，以及這條新成長曲線能帶來多少獲利。

輝達35億美元入股，合作從技術走向資本結盟
聯發科8月31日完成39億美元海外可轉換公司債(ECB)訂價，其中輝達認購35億美元，占比接近九成，Alphabet也參與認購。這筆交易讓雙方合作關係進一步深化，從原本的技術合作，延伸到資本層面的策略結盟。
目前雙方合作範圍涵蓋AI基礎建設、邊緣AI運算及車用平台等領域，其中AI基礎建設將聚焦NVLink Fusion客製化XPU，邊緣AI則涉及RTX Spark、DGX Spark等平台，車用領域也有合作布局。
對聯發科而言，這項合作的重要性並不只是取得一筆資金，而是進一步提高其在輝達AI生態系中的角色。若後續ASIC產品按照規畫於2026年第4季開始量產，並逐步擴大至2028年的營收貢獻，輝達的資本參與也讓市場更加關注這條AI ASIC成長路徑。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫)

8月營收創新高，提前拉貨效應仍要留意
聯發科9月10日公布8月營收達641.83億元，月增32.41%、年增44.08%，創下單月營收新高；7、8月累計營收則達1,126.58億元。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫)
不過，這次營收創高仍需要拆解來看。由於聯發科自9月起調升部分晶片價格，市場認為部分客戶可能在漲價生效前提前拉貨，因此8月營收大增，未必完全反映終端需求轉強。尤其手機業務仍面臨壓力。聯發科2026年第2季手機業務營收已季減14%、年減20%，全年手機晶片出貨量也預估將年減15%。因此，8月營收創高與手機需求偏弱其實可以同時存在。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫)

9月晶片漲價，真正關鍵在獲利結構
聯發科9月起部分晶片調漲5%至10%。目前市場預期，先進製程產品漲幅接近10%，成熟製程則約5%。在先進製程成本持續上升、ASIC產品初期毛利率又低於公司平均的情況下，漲價有助於抵銷部分成本壓力。
法人預估，聯發科2026年全年毛利率可能由原先約47%至48%，下修至45%至46%。市場目前預期，隨著ASIC逐步放量，聯發科營益率有機會由2025年的17%，逐步提升至2027年至2028年的20%至25%。

超微切入Google TPU，ASIC競爭開始升溫
不過，聯發科AI ASIC布局也不是沒有變數。市場傳出超微可能切入Google TPU v10供應鏈，引發市場對Google TPU訂單競爭的關注。聯發科目前已將2027年ASIC市場占有率目標上修至15%至20%，並持有TPU v8t、v9及v9延伸版Triggerfish等相關訂單，產品能見度延續至2029年。如果超微後續確實進一步取得Google TPU訂單，長期來看將增加AI ASIC市場的競爭程度，但短期訂單尚未動搖。

手機退居第二，AI ASIC才是聯發科下一階段觀察重點
如果把近期幾項變化放在一起看，聯發科正在經歷的可能不只是單季營收變化，而是產品結構逐步轉換。
過去市場看聯發科，核心仍集中在手機晶片需求，但隨著手機市場成長趨緩，聯發科未來的成長動能將逐步轉向智慧邊緣平台及AI ASIC。其中，智慧邊緣平台目前仍是重要的營收支柱，而AI ASIC則預計自2026年第4季開始逐步放量，並成為2027、2028年更重要的成長來源。
8月營收創新高固然亮眼，但其中包含漲價前提前拉貨因素。因此，對市場而言，接下來真正要追蹤的不是手機業務還會不會下滑，而是AI ASIC放量後，能不能如預期帶動營益率改善，以及聯發科能否守住Google等大型客戶的ASIC訂單。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫)

paras_en: MediaTek (2454‑TW) has recently undergone two major changes: Nvidia invested $3.5 billion to subscribe to MediaTek's overseas convertible bonds, and starting in September some of its chips will see price hikes of 5% to 10%. On the surface these are capital cooperation and price adjustments, but they may signal that MediaTek is accelerating its shift toward AI ASICs.

The collaboration now covers AI infrastructure, edge AI computing and automotive platforms. The AI infrastructure effort will focus on a customized XPU based on NVLink Fusion, edge AI will involve RTX Spark, DGX Spark and related platforms, and there is also a joint layout for automotive applications.

For MediaTek, the deal is important not only for the cash infusion but also for elevating its role within Nvidia’s AI ecosystem. If the ASIC products follow the plan to start mass production in Q4 2026 and gradually expand to contribute to revenue through 2028, Nvidia’s equity participation will draw even more market attention to this AI‑ASIC growth path.
(Source: Youshan Analysis Industry Database)

MediaTek announced on September 10 that August revenue reached NT$64.183 billion, up 32.41% month‑over‑month and 44.08% year‑over‑year, setting a new single‑month record; the combined revenue for July and August hit NT$112.658 billion.
(Source: Youshan Analysis Industry Database)

However, the record revenue needs to be dissected. Because MediaTek raised prices on some chips starting in September, the market believes some customers may have stocked up before the price increase took effect, inflating August sales without fully reflecting end‑user demand. The handset business remains under pressure: MediaTek’s Q2 2026 handset revenue is projected to fall 14% quarter‑over‑quarter and 20% year‑over‑year, and full‑year handset chip shipments are expected to decline 15% YoY. Thus, strong August revenue can coexist with weak phone demand.
(Source: Youshan Analysis Industry Database)

From September, MediaTek will raise prices on certain chips by 5% to 10%. The market expects near‑10% hikes for advanced‑process products and about 5% for mature‑process ones. With advanced‑process costs rising and early‑stage ASIC margins below the company average, the price increase helps offset some cost pressure.

Analysts estimate MediaTek’s full‑year gross margin for 2026 could be revised down from roughly 47‑48% to 45‑46%. The market currently expects that as ASIC volumes grow, MediaTek’s operating margin could rise from 17% in 2025 to between 20% and 25% in 2027‑2028.

AMD may enter the Google TPU supply chain, heating up ASIC competition. Rumors suggest AMD could start supplying Google’s TPU v10, drawing attention to competition for Google TPU orders. MediaTek has already raised its 2027 ASIC market‑share target to 15‑20% and holds orders for TPU v8t, v9 and the v9‑derived Triggerfish, keeping product visibility through 2029. If AMD later secures Google TPU orders, long‑term AI‑ASIC competition will intensify, though short‑term orders remain unchanged.

The handset segment is now secondary; AI ASICs are the next focus for MediaTek. Looking at the recent changes together, MediaTek appears to be undergoing not just a single‑quarter revenue swing but a gradual shift in product mix.

Historically, the market viewed MediaTek as a handset‑chip company, but as phone growth slows, its future growth engine will shift toward smart edge platforms and AI ASICs. Smart edge platforms remain a key revenue pillar today, while AI ASICs are expected to ramp up from Q4 2026 and become a more important growth source in 2027‑2028.

The August revenue record is impressive, but it includes pre‑price‑increase stockpiling. Therefore, the market should focus not on whether handset revenue will keep falling, but on whether AI ASIC volume expansion can deliver the expected margin improvement and whether MediaTek can retain large customers such as Google for ASIC orders.
(Source: Youshan Analysis Industry Database)

items.title: 金管會最新人事 周正山接任金融市場發展及創新處處長
items.title_en: Financial Supervisory Commission Announces Latest Personnel Change: Zhou Zhengshan Appointed Director of Financial Market Development and Innovation Division
paras: 金管會今(14)日宣布最新人事異動，金融市場發展及創新處處長一職，由原銀行局主任秘書周正山調陞；原創新處處長林羲聖則派任金管會參事。本項人事案已於2026年9月7日經行政院核定，並於今日正式到任生效。
金管會表示，新任創新處處長周正山學經歷相當完整，畢業於國立政治大學公共行政學系，並取得國立政治大學公共行政學系及國立臺灣大學經濟學系雙碩士學位。考選資格方面，於民國84年通過公務人員高等考試二等考試人事行政類科及格。
周正山處長深耕金融監理與管理體系多年，歷任金管會科長、金管會銀行局專門委員、副組長、組長及主任秘書等要職。憑藉其在銀行監理、法規與經濟政策上的紮實專業背景，未來可望帶領創新處持續推動金融科技發展、市場創新應用及金融產業競爭力之提升。
paras_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission announced today (the 14th) its latest personnel changes: the position of Director of the Financial Market Development and Innovation Division will be filled by Zhou Zhengshan, formerly the Secretary-General of the Banking Bureau; the former Director of the Innovation Division, Lin Xi-sheng, will be appointed as a consultant to the Commission. This personnel decision was approved by the Executive Yuan on September 7, 2026, and takes effect today.

The Commission noted that the newly appointed Director of the Innovation Division, Zhou Zhengshan, has a comprehensive academic background, having graduated from the Department of Public Administration at National Chengchi University and earned dual master’s degrees from National Chengchi University’s Public Administration program and the Department of Economics at National Taiwan University. He passed the second‑level civil service examination in the personnel administration category in 1995 (the 84th year of the Republic of China).

Director Zhou Zhengshan has spent many years deepening his expertise in financial supervision and management systems, having served in senior roles such as Section Chief at the Commission, specialist commissioner, deputy division chief, division chief, and Secretary‑General of the Banking Bureau. Leveraging his solid professional background in bank supervision, regulations, and economic policy, he is expected to lead the Innovation Division in continuing to promote fintech development, market‑innovation applications, and the enhancement of the financial industry’s competitiveness.

items.title: 高CP值國宅仍是熱門交易社區  成功等7大國宅撐起熱銷榜半邊天
items.title_en: High Cost‑Performance Public Housing Remains a Popular Trading Community; Chenggong and Seven Other Public Housing Projects Support Half of the Hot‑Sale Rankings
paras: 房仲業者依內政部實價登錄資料，盤點近一年台北市十大熱銷社區。數據顯示，萬華區「台北晶麒」累計成交34戶奪冠；國宅社區則憑藉地段機能與價格優勢，一舉攻佔7個席位。此外，多數上榜社區房價低於所屬行政區平均行情，顯見相對實惠的價格成為購屋族入主該區域的替代選擇。
針對再度蟬聯熱銷交易冠軍「台北晶麒」。永慶房屋研展中心副理陳金萍表示，該社區位於龍山寺生活圈，周邊商圈發展成熟，且屋齡約10年，在老屋林立的萬華區中格外稀缺。雖然近一年「台北晶麒」平均單價76.6萬元，每坪較行政區均價高出8萬元，但因產品規劃多為中小坪數，總價門檻相對容易負擔；對購屋族而言，不僅能免去老屋翻修的隱形成本，又能享有飯店式管理與完善公設，因此深受小資族群青睞，買氣持續穩健。
台北市十大熱銷社區榜單中，高性價比的「國宅」依舊是市場焦點，共有7個國宅社區上榜。陳金萍指出，國宅具備公設比低、實際使用空間大的特點，且多座落於開發成熟、交通便利的核心地段，加上價格普遍較所在行政區親民，因此在市場上流通性極高。

進一步觀察，大安區與萬華區並列最熱銷行政區，各有3個社區上榜，且大安區上榜的「成功國宅」、「大安國宅」與「郵政新村」都是國宅。其中排名第二的「成功國宅」近一年成交量24件，平均單價為86萬元，與行政區整體均價113.8萬元相比，每坪可省下27.8萬元，是榜單中價差最大的社區。陳金萍說明，成功國宅坐落於捷運科技大樓站周邊，生活機能優異，並擁有國北教大實小、大安國中等明星學區光環。對於預算有限、但想卡位黃金門牌與優質教育資源的家庭而言，相當具有吸引力。
另一亮點是中山區的「春暉新世界」，平均總價僅821萬元，是榜上唯一總價「千萬元有找」的社區。陳金萍說，該社區鄰近捷運中山國小站，交通與生活機能極佳，以小坪數的套房產品為主，超低總價吸引預算有限的首購與通勤族買盤。不過「春暉新世界」屬於住商混合型社區，戶數規模大，且屋齡超過40年，購屋前需將住戶出入複雜、公設維護不易等特性納入考量。
整體而言，陳金萍補充，台北市十大熱銷社區可提供民眾購屋時參考，通常具備較佳的市場接受度及流通性。不過，熱銷不等於可以滿足所有購屋族需求，建議民眾仍應進一步比較屋齡、社區修繕、管理品質、土地持分與個別樓層條件，並依自身財務能力審慎評估。
paras_en: According to the Ministry of the Interior’s real‑price registration data, real‑estate agents compiled a list of the top ten hottest communities in Taipei over the past year. The data show that the “Taipei Jingqi” community in Wanhua District led the list with 34 transactions, while public‑housing communities captured seven of the ten spots thanks to their location advantages and lower prices. Moreover, most of the listed communities have unit prices below the average for their respective districts, indicating that relatively affordable pricing has become an alternative choice for homebuyers entering these areas.

Regarding the repeat champion “Taipei Jingqi,” Chen Jin‑ping, deputy manager of the Yong‑qing Real Estate Research Center, said the community is located in the Longshan Temple lifestyle circle, surrounded by a mature commercial district, and the buildings are about ten years old, making them especially scarce among the many older structures in Wanhua. Although its average price over the past year was NT$7.66 million per ping—about NT$800,000 higher than the district average—the projects mainly consist of small‑to‑medium units, keeping the total price threshold relatively affordable. For buyers, this means avoiding the hidden costs of renovating older homes while enjoying hotel‑style management and comprehensive public facilities, which has made the community especially popular with young professionals and its sales momentum remains steady.

In the top‑ten list of Taipei’s hottest communities, high‑value‑for‑money public housing remains a market focus, with seven public‑housing estates making the list. Chen noted that public housing features low common‑area ratios and larger usable spaces, and most are situated in well‑developed, transit‑convenient core locations. Coupled with prices that are generally more affordable than the surrounding district averages, these factors give public housing very high market liquidity.

A closer look shows that Da’an District and Wanhua District tie for the hottest administrative districts, each contributing three communities to the list. In Da’an, the “Chenggong Public Housing,” “Da’an Public Housing,” and “Postal New Village” are all public‑housing projects. The second‑ranked “Chenggong Public Housing” recorded 24 transactions in the past year with an average price of NT$8.6 million per ping, saving NT$2.78 million per ping compared with the district’s overall average of NT$11.38 million—the largest price gap on the list. Chen explained that Chenggong is located near the Technology Building MRT station, boasts excellent living amenities, and is surrounded by prestigious school zones such as the National Taiwan University of Science and Technology elementary school and Da’an Junior High. For families with limited budgets who still want a prime address and quality education resources, it is particularly attractive.

Another highlight is the “Chunhui New World” in Zhongshan District, whose average total price is only NT$8.21 million, making it the only community on the list with a total price under ten million. Chen said the development is close to the Zhongshan Elementary School MRT station, offering excellent transportation and lifestyle convenience, and mainly offers small‑size studio units, whose ultra‑low total price appeals to first‑time buyers and commuters with limited budgets. However, Chunhui New World is a mixed‑use residential‑commercial community with a large number of units and a building age exceeding 40 years, so prospective buyers should consider the complexity of resident traffic and the difficulty of maintaining common areas.

Overall, Chen added that Taipei’s top‑ten hottest communities can serve as a reference for homebuyers because they generally enjoy better market acceptance and liquidity. Nevertheless, hot‑selling status does not guarantee that a community meets every buyer’s needs; she advises buyers to further compare building age, community repairs, management quality, land‑share ratios, and individual floor conditions, and to assess these factors carefully against their own financial capabilities.

items.title: 外資單月狂買3568億創新高！AI浪潮發威 法人看好今年台股獲利成長逾4成
items.title_en: Foreign Investors Set Record Monthly Purchase of NT$356.8 Billion! AI Wave Fuels Gains, Institutions Expect Over 40% Profit Growth for Taiwan Stocks This Year
paras: 受惠於AI投資需求暢旺與科技供應鏈持續擴張，帶動今年來台股漲幅在亞洲主要市場中名列前茅。柏瑞投信表示，儘管仍有美國聯準會利率政策走向、通膨及國際油價走揚等不確定因素，使得台股仍有短線高檔震盪的機率，但在經濟基本面穩健和企業獲利增長強勁的支撐下，預期2026年台股獲利成長率達40%以上，多頭格局並未改變，加上外資單月狂買3568億元創新高，AI供應鏈接棒，讓台股續攻有底氣。
柏瑞投信指出，在歷經前波修正後，台股8月展開強勁反彈，外資單月買超達3568億元，創歷史單月新高，成為推升本周行情的重要資金動能。整體而言，台股AI主線依然明確，盤勢已由去槓桿修正轉向外資回流與獲利預期修復。
此外，台股此波的反彈除了來自資金回流，基本面亦提供支撐。台灣7月出口達753億美元、年增32%，AI伺服器、半導體及資通產品仍是主要成長來源；更具領先意義的外銷訂單亦創歷史新高，其中資訊通信與電子產品的接單分別年增89.5%及71.7%，顯示全球AI資本支出正持續轉化為台灣科技供應鏈的實質需求。
柏瑞投信投資策略部副總經理鄭筑文表示，觀察台股企業獲利上修趨勢自2025年下半年以來延續至今，尚未出現反轉訊號。市場預期台股2026年獲利成長率達40以上，由此推估台股評價面仍合理，成為台股多頭格局的重要支撐。其中，又以科技相關次產業的獲利動能最強，顯示AI投資浪潮對台灣產業基本面的支撐力道仍強，亦已成為台股中長期的重要成長動能。
鄭筑文進一步指出，儘管市場不時質疑AI是否存在泡沫風險，但4大雲端供應商仍持續加碼資本支出，根據外資券商Morgan Stanley在5月底的統計，這4大供應商的2026年資本支出規模合計將近7400億美元，2027年更將超越1兆美元。主要業者至今未見縮減投資跡象，反映出AI需求仍具延續性，產業動能並未改變。
此外，AI發展已從單一應用延伸至整體基礎建設升級，帶動半導體製程、傳輸材料及資料中心3大領域同步擴張。隨著運算效能持續提升，產業對高規格產品的需求增加，推動供應鏈朝高附加價值的方向發展，為相關企業創造長期成長機會。
柏瑞巨人基金經理人高豪志表示，隨著台股行情從8月展開反彈，融資餘額亦回升至目前約新台幣5800億元，顯示市場信心逐步回溫。觀察目前整體融資水位仍低於前波7月中高點的6313億元，籌碼結構亦相對改善，但後續仍須留意融資增幅與指數表現是否維持合理節奏。當前投資環境正處於高評價與高成長並存的階段，選股的重要性將明顯高於單純押注市場整體方向。
展望後市，鄭筑文表示，台股第4季仍可能面臨高檔震盪，下一階段企業能否將訂單成長與規格升級，進一步轉化為營收、毛利率與獲利成長，將成為股價表現分化的關鍵。隨著AI基礎建設由「增加算力」走向「提升系統效率」，產業價值也由運算晶片轉向先進封裝、高階材料、高速傳輸、電源與散熱。台股投資將持續聚焦具備技術門檻、訂單能見度與定價能力，且有望透過規格升級帶動獲利上修的企業。
paras_en: Benefiting from strong AI investment demand and the continued expansion of the tech supply chain, Taiwan’s stock market has posted one of the best gains among major Asian markets this year. Baillie Gifford Investment Trust notes that despite uncertainties such as the direction of U.S. Fed rate policy, inflation and rising global oil prices, which could cause short‑term high‑level volatility, solid economic fundamentals and robust corporate earnings support an expected profit growth rate of over 40% for 2026. The bullish outlook remains unchanged, especially as foreign investors set a new monthly purchase record of NT$356.8 billion and the AI supply chain passes the baton, giving the market confidence to keep advancing.

Baillie Gifford points out that after a previous correction, the Taiwan market rebounded strongly in August, with foreign investors net‑buying NT$356.8 billion in a single month – a historic high that became a key driver of this week’s rally. Overall, the AI theme in Taiwan remains clear, and market dynamics have shifted from deleveraging corrections to foreign capital inflows and a recovery in earnings expectations.

In addition, the current rebound is not only fueled by capital returning but also supported by fundamentals. Taiwan’s July exports reached US$75.3 billion, up 32% year‑on‑year, with AI servers, semiconductors and ICT products still the main growth drivers. Export orders also hit record highs, with information‑communication and electronic product orders up 89.5% and 71.7% respectively, showing that global AI capex is translating into real demand for Taiwan’s tech supply chain.

Zheng Zhu‑wen, deputy head of Baillie Gifford’s investment strategy unit, said the upward revision trend in corporate earnings that began in the second half of 2025 has continued without any reversal signals. The market expects a profit growth rate above 40% for 2026, implying that valuations remain reasonable and underpin the bullish stance. Among sub‑sectors, technology‑related industries show the strongest earnings momentum, indicating that the AI investment wave still strongly supports Taiwan’s industrial fundamentals and has become a key medium‑ to long‑term growth engine for the market.

Zheng added that although some question whether AI carries a bubble risk, the four major cloud providers are still ramping up capital spending. According to Morgan Stanley’s late‑May data, the combined 2026 capex of these four providers will approach US$740 billion, exceeding US$1 trillion in 2027. The main players have shown no sign of cutting back, reflecting the persistence of AI demand and unchanged industry momentum.

Furthermore, AI development has moved beyond single applications to a broader infrastructure upgrade, driving simultaneous expansion in three areas: semiconductor processes, transmission materials and data‑center equipment. As computing power continues to rise, demand for higher‑specification products grows, pushing the supply chain toward higher‑value‑added offerings and creating long‑term growth opportunities for related companies.

Gao Hao‑zhi, portfolio manager of Baillie Gifford’s Giant Fund, said that as the market rallied from August, margin financing balances rose to about NT$580 billion, indicating a gradual recovery in market confidence. While the current financing level remains below the July mid‑high of NT$6.313 billion and the chip structure has improved, attention must still be paid to whether financing growth and index performance stay in a reasonable rhythm. The present investment environment features both high valuations and high growth, making stock selection far more important than simply betting on the market direction.

Looking ahead, Zheng cautioned that the fourth quarter may still see high‑level volatility. The key will be whether companies can turn order growth and specification upgrades into higher revenue, margins and profits, which will drive stock‑price divergence. As AI infrastructure shifts from “adding compute power” to “enhancing system efficiency,” industry value is moving from compute chips to advanced packaging, high‑end materials, high‑speed interconnects, power and cooling. Investment focus will remain on firms with technical barriers, visible orders and pricing power that can boost earnings through specification upgrades.

items.title: AI行為準則今公布！微軟執行長納德拉：支持AI審慎發展與嵌入式評估機制
items.title_en: AI Code of Conduct Unveiled Today! Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella: Supports Prudent AI Development and Embedded Evaluation Mechanisms
paras: 微軟執行長納德拉週(13)日在X平台上發文談及微軟的先進AI發展理念，認為任何對超級智慧的探索都必須在核心原則約束下運作。如果人們建構的AI無法幫助人類，無法被人類控制，就不值得發展。
但他認為，AI需要加速發展，使其成果能廣泛傳播，並惠及不同國家、社區和企業。這顯然需要建立前沿生態，讓開源和閉源模型都能蓬勃發展。對企業來說，這意味著他們必須完全掌握自身獨有的隱性知識。每家公司都應該可以建構屬於自己的、持續學習循環、不斷迭代的系統，而不必依賴單一模型供應商，還應將自身知識融入模型中。
在此背景下，納德拉表示，他歡迎必要的研究、關注和有意識的推進節奏，以確保「對齊」成為設計目標。
他也歡迎「嵌入式評估器」等概念，以及更廣泛的努力，推動建立相關機制，讓這些理念不只是停留在口語層面。
納德拉還強調，這一領域不能由少數幾個實體控制，必須讓整個生態系統、不同國家和各個領域，包括學術界，都廣泛參與其中。
他同時表示，微軟的方案是在AI技術堆疊的每一層提供廣泛存取權限與選擇，以及支撐微軟自研MAI模型的《行為準則》。該準則將於週一(13日)發布，公開徵求意見。
paras_en: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella posted on X on Tuesday (the 13th) about the company’s advanced AI development philosophy, stating that any exploration of superintelligence must operate under core principles. If the AI we build cannot help humanity or be controlled by humans, it is not worth developing.

He added that AI needs to accelerate so its benefits can be widely disseminated and reach different countries, communities and businesses. This clearly requires building a frontier ecosystem where both open‑source and closed‑source models can thrive. For enterprises, this means they must fully own their proprietary tacit knowledge. Each company should be able to build its own continuously learning, iterating system without relying on a single model vendor, and embed its own knowledge into the models.
In this context, Nadella said he welcomes necessary research, attention and a conscious pace of progress to ensure that “alignment” becomes a design goal.
He also welcomed concepts such as “embedded evaluators” and broader efforts to establish mechanisms that move these ideas beyond mere rhetoric.
Nadella emphasized that this field must not be controlled by a few entities; the entire ecosystem, different nations and sectors—including academia—must be broadly involved.

He added that Microsoft’s approach is to provide broad access and choice at every layer of the AI technology stack, and to support Microsoft’s internally developed MAI model with a “Code of Conduct.” The code will be released on Monday the 13th for public comment.

items.title: Anthropic傳選定那斯達克上市！最快10月IPO、募資規模上看超越SpaceX
items.title_en: Anthropic Chooses Nasdaq for Listing! IPO as Early as October, Fundraising Size May Surpass SpaceX
paras: 知情人士透露，Anthropic已選定那斯達克（Nasdaq）作為潛在首次公開募股（IPO）的上市地點，若最終成行，這家Claude聊天機器人開發商的上市規模可能刷新紀錄。
根據《彭博》報導，知情人士表示，Anthropic尋求透過IPO募資的金額，可能達到或超過SpaceX(SPCX-US) 的規模，這宗IPO最快可能在10月進行。
若Anthropic在那斯達克掛牌，將是該交易所今年的又一項勝利。今年美國規模最大的4宗IPO均在那斯達克進行，其中包括SpaceX於6月創下紀錄的863億美元IPO。
數週後，SK海力士（SK Hynix Inc.）也在7月上市，募得265億美元。《Business Insider》先前已報導Anthropic選擇那斯達克的消息。
Anthropic積極籌備上市之際，人工智慧（AI）產業的快速發展與潛在風險也成為業界高層近期關注焦點。
OpenAI執行長Sam Altman、Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei及馬斯週六（12日）均表示，隨著AI技術帶來的風險升高，有必要放慢AI發展速度。
Altman接受《財富》訪問時則表示，OpenAI今年不會上市，理由與安全疑慮有關。
此外，《彭博》此前報導，Anthropic本月稍早原定敲定一筆150億美元的循環信用額度。
AI競賽升溫也帶動美國IPO市場復甦。根據《彭博》彙整數據，今年美國IPO募資總額已達1,606億美元，不包括特殊目的收購公司（SPAC）及其他金融工具，創下2021年以來單年度最高紀錄。
Anthropic本身的營收成長也十分迅速。按照目前業績表現推算，Anthropic年化營收已突破650億美元，較去年底的年化營收速度增加逾7倍。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Insiders say Anthropic has selected Nasdaq as the venue for its potential initial public offering, and if it goes ahead, the Claude chatbot developer could set a record with the size of its listing.
According to Bloomberg, sources indicate Anthropic is aiming to raise an amount through the IPO that could match or exceed SpaceX (SPCX-US), with the offering possibly occurring as early as October.
If Anthropic lists on Nasdaq, it will be another win for the exchange this year. The four largest U.S. IPOs this year were all on Nasdaq, including SpaceX's record‑breaking $86.3 billion IPO in June.
Weeks later, SK Hynix also went public in July, raising $26.5 billion. Business Insider had previously reported Anthropic's choice of Nasdaq.
As Anthropic prepares for a listing, the rapid growth and potential risks of the AI industry have become a focus for senior executives.
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and Elon Musk on Saturday (the 12th) all said that rising AI‑related risks make it necessary to slow the pace of AI development.
Altman told Fortune that OpenAI will not go public this year, citing safety concerns.
Bloomberg also reported earlier this month that Anthropic had planned to secure a $15 billion revolving credit facility.

The heated AI competition is reviving the U.S. IPO market. Bloomberg data show that total U.S. IPO proceeds this year have reached $160.6 billion, excluding SPACs and other instruments, the highest annual total since 2021.
Anthropic's revenue growth is also rapid. Based on current performance, its annualized revenue has already exceeded $65 billion, more than seven times the annualized rate at the end of last year.
(This article is not available for partner re‑publication)

items.title: 網路泡沫既視感重現！債息油價齊飆　華爾街老將：今年像90年代末 但未到離場時
items.title_en: Internet Bubble Déjà Vu Returns! Yields and Oil Prices Surge — Wall Street Veteran: This Year Feels Like Late 1990s, But It's Not Time to Exit
paras: 美債殖利率飆升與油價暴漲，令華爾街老將聯想到網路泡沫破滅前的氛圍，但他們認為，這還不足以成為離場理由。
當前股市面臨多重逆風，10年期美債殖利率逼近5%，長債殖利率接近2007年以來高位；西德州中質原油(WTI)價格徘徊在每桶100美元附近，美伊戰爭持續推高能源價格，交易員押注聯準會(Fed)本周將升息應對頑固通膨，加上9月向來為股市弱勢表現月份，看似是拋售時機。標普500指數自6月初以來幾乎原地踏步，此前五個月累計上漲11%，且連三年呈雙位數漲幅表現。
即便如此，在通膨數據提升升息機率下，美股上週五(11日)仍走漲，投資者逢低買入。
Roundhill Investments首席投資策略師Drew Pettit表示：「股市就像一隻鴨子，表面風平浪靜，水下卻在拼命划動雙腳。」
市場將當前與1990年代末比較並非無理，美銀與CIBC資本市場策略師指出，科技股曾在Fed升息周期及美債殖利率上升環境中維持上漲數年，最終才迎來泡沫破裂。
Angeles Investment Advisors首席投資官Michael Rosen則表示，更大風險在於錯過牛市最後一段行情，因為這階段通常回報最為豐厚。
Rosemn並非預言牛市結束，但若真結束，先錯過上漲再試圖重新進場幾乎不可能。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury yields are soaring and oil prices are spiking, reminding Wall Street veterans of the atmosphere before the dot‑com bubble burst, but they say that alone is not enough reason to get out of the market.

The equity market currently faces multiple headwinds: the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield is nearing 5%, long‑term yields are close to their highest levels since 2007; West Texas Intermediate crude is hovering around $100 a barrel, with the ongoing Israel‑Iran conflict pushing energy prices higher. Traders are betting the Fed will raise rates this week to combat stubborn inflation, and September has traditionally been a weak month for stocks, making it seem like a selling opportunity. The S&P 500 has been essentially flat since early June, after gaining 11% over the prior five months and delivering double‑digit annual returns for three consecutive years.
Nevertheless, with inflation data increasing the odds of another rate hike, U.S. equities still rose last Friday (the 11th), as investors bought on dips.
Drew Pettit, chief investment strategist at Roundhill Investments, said: “The stock market is like a duck – calm on the surface while frantically paddling underneath.”

Comparing the current environment to the late 1990s is not unreasonable; strategists at Bank of America and CIBC’s capital markets noted that tech stocks managed to climb for several years during Fed‑tightening cycles and rising Treasury yields before the bubble finally burst.
Michael Rosen, chief investment officer at Angeles Investment Advisors, warned that the bigger risk is missing the final leg of the bull market, which typically delivers the richest returns.
Rosemn is not predicting the end of the bull market, but if it does end, missing the rally and then trying to re‑enter would be virtually impossible.

items.title: 蘇姿丰賭Agentic AI贏了！AMD超越高通成全球第三大晶片設計廠 輝達穩居冠、聯發科第五
items.title_en: Su Zifeng’s Bet on Agentic AI Pays Off! AMD Overtakes Qualcomm to Become the World’s Third‑Largest Chip Designer, Nvidia Stays on Top, MediaTek Fifth
paras: 根據TrendForce(集邦咨詢)最新研究報告，今年第二季全球前十大無晶圓廠IC設計合計營收1414.5億美元，年增73%，AI GPU、CPU、ASIC與高速互連需求主導排名重洗，最大變動是超微(AMD)以115.3億美元超越高通、升至第三。
AI晶片大廠輝達穩居榜首，今年Q2營收近911.6億美元、年增99%，占前十大64%，客戶由雲端巨頭擴至新雲廠(Neo Cloud)、主權AI與企業端，博通則以營收188.9億美元次之，年增率112%，主要受惠於OpenAI首款ASIC、谷歌TPU 8i出貨及XPU網通需求。
超微則受Agentic AI拉抬CPU戰略價值，資料中心CPU連五季創高，持續蠶食X86伺服器份額，高通則被超微擠到第四、營收逾85億美元，新一代iPhone基頻供應份額下滑，但車用晶片連23季雙位數增長，近期重返資料中心、加速QCT多元化。
台灣廠商聯發科約48.1億美元排第五，手機業務承壓，該公司上調AI ASIC展望，預估2026年資料中心營收逾20億美元，2028年ASIC可服務市場升至800億美元。
整體來看，AI算力正把無晶圓設計格局由手機消費驅動，改寫為資料中心、客製晶片與互連並進。
paras_en: According to TrendForce’s latest research report, the combined revenue of the world’s top ten fabless IC designers in Q2 of this year reached $141.45 billion, up 73% year‑over‑year, driven by demand for AI GPUs, CPUs, ASICs and high‑speed interconnects that reshuffled the rankings. The biggest change was AMD, with $11.53 billion in revenue, overtaking Qualcomm to climb to third place.

AI chip giant Nvidia remained at the top of the list, posting Q2 revenue of about $91.16 billion, a 99% year‑over‑year increase, accounting for 64% of the top ten’s total. Its customer base expanded from cloud giants to new cloud players (Neo Cloud), sovereign AI projects and enterprise customers. Broadcom came in second with $18.89 billion in revenue, up 112% year‑over‑year, boosted by the first OpenAI ASIC, Google’s TPU 8i shipments and XPU networking demand.

AMD’s rise was fueled by the strategic value of Agentic AI for its CPUs, with data‑center CPU sales hitting a five‑quarter high and continuing to eat into the x86 server market share. Qualcomm was pushed down to fourth with revenue just over $8.5 billion; its share of next‑generation iPhone baseband supply fell, though its automotive chip business posted double‑digit growth for 23 consecutive quarters and it is recently re‑entering data‑center and accelerating QCT diversification.

Taiwan’s MediaTek posted roughly $4.81 billion in revenue, ranking fifth. Its handset business is under pressure, but the company raised its AI ASIC outlook, forecasting data‑center revenue of more than $2 billion by 2026 and an ASIC‑serviceable market of $80 billion by 2028.
Overall, AI compute power is shifting the fabless design landscape away from being driven by mobile consumer demand toward a mix of data‑center, custom chips and interconnect solutions.

items.title: 成立5年衝2兆估值？IPO前夕秀連兩季獲利成績   Anthropic給「AI燒錢焦慮」打強心針
items.title_en: Five Years Old, Aiming for $2 Trillion Valuation? IPO‑Ready Anthropic Shows Profit for Two Consecutive Quarters, Eases AI‑Spending Anxiety
paras: 外媒引述知情人士最新報導指出，Claude開發商Anthropic在籌備大型IPO前夕釋出利好，該公司本季度調整後營業利潤有望連續第二季為正，統計口徑剔除股權激勵等成本，而此舉意在緩解投資人對先進AI公司「燒錢太快」的疑慮。
《金融時報》報導，財務面顯示，在扣除向亞馬遜等經銷夥伴的收益分成、以及新模型訓練成本之前，Anthropic毛利率高於80%。第二季營收約115億美元，大幅年增14倍。截至7月底，年化營收達650億美元，遠高於去年底90億美元。
對一家成立僅五年、估值約9650億美元的新創公司而言，連續獲利將是衝擊公開市場的重要里程碑。
SemiAnalysis分析師Joey Brookhart說，若Anthropic能維持此一利潤率與增速，憑藉海量算力資源，競爭對手將很難追趕，投資人甚至預估Anthropic全年年化營收可達1200億美元，2027年底再倍增近兩倍。
上市安排方面，知情人士透露，Anthropic已選定那斯達克交易所，估值目標可能達2兆美元甚至更高。對此Anthropic拒絕置評。Anthropic原定上月公開的招股書改為先向少數股東傳閱、答詢後再對外披露。
不過，AI安全審視正與商業擴張交錯。上週六，Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei呼籲行業放慢最先進模型能力提升，提出獨立第三方評估、同業安全協調與國際合作三步架構，稱「必須為前沿設定節奏」，而OpenAI執行長奧特曼、xAI的馬斯克均公開認同。奧特曼同時表示，因安全顧慮，OpenAI今年不上市。
對潛在投資人來說，矛盾在於：放緩研發可省數十億美元訓練費，但也可能讓對手縮小差距。若安全管控趨嚴、模型迭代延後，則高估值所依賴的營收增速與算力利用率都需重新定價。
Anthropic一邊展示獲利與650億美元年化營收，一邊加入「降速」共識，正好反映出先進AI模型從狂奔擴張轉向合規變現的過渡期。
paras_en: Foreign media citing insiders reports that Claude developer Anthropic, on the eve of preparing a large IPO, released good news: the company's adjusted operating profit this quarter is expected to be positive for the second consecutive quarter, statistics exclude equity incentive costs, and this move aims to ease investors' concerns about advanced AI companies "burning cash too fast".

The Financial Times reported that financially, before deducting revenue shares to distributors such as Amazon and new model training costs, Anthropic's gross margin exceeds 80%. Q2 revenue about $11.5 billion, up 14‑fold year‑over‑year. As of end July, annualized revenue reached $65 billion, far above $9 billion at the end of last year.
For a startup only five years old with a valuation of about $965 billion, consecutive profitability will be a crucial milestone for a public‑market debut.

SemiAnalysis analyst Joey Brookhart said that if Anthropic can maintain this profit margin and growth rate, leveraging massive compute resources, rivals will find it hard to catch up; investors even project Anthropic's full‑year annualized revenue could reach $120 billion, and by the end of 2027 double to nearly twice that.

Regarding the listing, insiders say Anthropic has chosen the Nasdaq exchange, with a valuation target that could reach $2 trillion or higher. Anthropic declined to comment. The prospectus originally slated for public release last month was changed to circulate first to a small group of shareholders for Q&A before broader disclosure.

However, AI safety scrutiny is intersecting with commercial expansion. Last Saturday, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called on the industry to slow the advancement of the most advanced model capabilities, proposing a three‑step framework of independent third‑party assessment, peer safety coordination, and international cooperation, saying "we must set the pace for the frontier." OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and xAI’s Elon Musk both publicly agreed. Altman also said that for safety reasons OpenAI will not go public this year.

For potential investors, the dilemma is: slowing R&D can save tens of billions of dollars in training costs, but may also let competitors close the gap. If safety controls tighten and model iteration is delayed, the revenue growth and compute utilization that underpin the high valuation would need to be re‑priced.

Anthropic is showcasing profit and $65 billion annualized revenue while joining the "slow‑down" consensus, reflecting the transition of advanced AI models from a sprint of expansion to a compliance‑driven monetization phase.

items.title: 跳票近9年終亮相！新一代特斯拉Roadster定檔
items.title_en: After Nearly Nine Years of Delays, the New‑Generation Tesla Roadster Finally Debuts
paras: 美國電動車大廠特斯拉（Tesla）(TSLA-US) 長期追蹤者Sawyer Merritt周日（13日）在社交媒體上表示，特斯拉已正式向新一代Roadster預訂持有者寄送揭幕活動邀請函，活動定10月1日在美國德州韋科市（Waco）舉行。
這場被馬斯克稱為「史詩級」的發表會，象徵這款跳票近9年的傳奇超跑終於要走到聚光燈下。
邀請函顯示，活動地點選在韋科，位於奧斯汀以北約1.5小時車程處，鄰近SpaceX位於McGregor的火箭測試基地。
揭幕活動的門票不可轉讓、實名入場，且僅限21歲以上人士參加。
從場地選擇和年齡限制來看，這場發表會很可能會涉及SpaceX冷氣推進器的實車點火演示，因為該推進器噪音極大，存在聽力損傷風險。
回顧這款超跑的跳票史，新一代Roadster幾乎貫穿了特斯拉近十年產品規劃。
2017年11月，原型車首次亮相時，特斯拉承諾2020年量產，此後節點一路後滑，2020年執行長馬斯克改口「12至18個月後」，2021年因供應鏈推遲，2022年再度延後，2023年馬斯克在社交媒體上承認「還沒準備好」。
在去年11月特斯拉股東大會上，馬斯克把演示日期定在2026年4月1日愚人節，他當時公開承認這個日期讓自己保留了「可否認餘地」。
4月未能落地後又推至4月下旬、再推至8月，直到9月初特斯拉方面仍僅表示「很快」。如今邀請函終於發出，跳票輪次累計已超過八次。
根據特斯拉此前公布的數據，新一代Roadster基礎版0-60英里/小時加速1.9秒，選裝SpaceX套件可進一步壓縮至1.1秒，輪上扭矩10000N·m，極速超過250英里/小時（約400km/h），續航620英里（約1,000公里），四座四驅。
其SpaceX套件搭載的冷氣推進器內部代號A71，利用壓縮氣體定向噴射產生推力，技術源自航天器姿態控制模組。
售價方面，基礎版預訂金5萬美元，Founders Series創始人版預訂買家需付全款25萬美元，整車售價預估在20萬至25萬美元之間，量產進度預計2027年啟動。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA‑US) long‑time follower Sawyer Merritt posted on social media on Sunday the 13th that Tesla has officially mailed invitation letters for the unveiling event to pre‑order holders of the new‑generation Roadster, with the event scheduled for October 1 in Waco, Texas, USA.
The event, which Elon Musk called an “epic‑level” launch, signals that the legendary supercar, delayed for almost nine years, is finally stepping into the spotlight.
The invitation shows the venue is in Waco, about a 1.5‑hour drive north of Austin, near SpaceX’s rocket‑test facility in McGregor.
Tickets to the unveiling are non‑transferable, require real‑name registration, and are limited to participants aged 21 or older.
Given the venue choice and age restriction, the launch is likely to include a live ignition demo of SpaceX’s cold‑air thruster, which is extremely loud and poses a risk of hearing damage.
Looking back at the supercar’s history of delays, the new Roadster has spanned almost a decade of Tesla’s product planning.

When the prototype first appeared in November 2017, Tesla promised mass production in 2020; the timeline slipped repeatedly—Musk later said “12 to 18 months later,” supply‑chain issues pushed it to 2021, further delays in 2022, and in 2023 Musk admitted on social media that it was “still not ready.”
At last year’s shareholder meeting in November, Musk set the demonstration date for April 1, 2026—April Fool’s Day—and openly acknowledged that the date gave him “room to backtrack.”

After missing the April target, the date was moved to late April, then to August, and by early September Tesla only said “very soon.” The invitation finally sent out brings the total number of postponements to more than eight.

According to data previously released by Tesla, the base model of the new Roadster accelerates 0‑60 mph in 1.9 seconds, which can be trimmed to 1.1 seconds with the optional SpaceX package; it delivers 10,000 N·m of wheel torque, tops out over 250 mph (≈400 km/h), has a range of 620 miles (≈1,000 km), and features four seats with all‑wheel drive.
The SpaceX package’s cold‑air thruster, internally codenamed A71, generates thrust by directional jetting of compressed gas, a technology derived from spacecraft attitude‑control modules.

Pricing: the base‑model reservation requires a $50,000 deposit; the Founders Series requires full payment of $250,000; the full vehicle is estimated to cost between $200,000 and $250,000, with mass‑production slated to start in 2027.

items.title: OpenAI傳擬牽手三星代工AI晶片？下一代ASIC成合作新焦點
items.title_en: OpenAI Said to Be Eyeing Samsung for AI Chip Foundry? Next-Gen ASIC Becomes New Collaboration Focus
paras: OpenAI與三星電子(005930KS) 的合作可能進一步從記憶體供應及企業人工智慧（AI）服務，延伸至AI晶片製造。
根據《路透》報導，OpenAI韓國總經理Harrison Kim本週在首爾記者會上表示，雙方在下一代晶片的「共同生產與研究」方面已取得顯著進展，引發OpenAI可能尋求三星代工生產AI處理器的討論。
Kim表示：「我們與三星電子合作中，取得最大進展並獲得最多肯定的領域之一，就是我們正在開發的下一代晶片的共同生產與研究。」不過，他並未進一步說明。
OpenAI目前已布局自有AI特殊應用積體電路（ASIC）計畫，並與博通(AVGO-US) 合作進行晶片設計，同時由台積電(2330-TW) 提供晶圓製造及先進封裝服務。
OpenAI先前推出首款推理AI加速器Jalapeño，從晶片定義、與博通共同設計到交由台積電製造，整體開發時間不到18個月。
不過，目前尚無法確認三星若加入OpenAI的晶片供應鏈，究竟是作為Jalapeño的第二代工來源、負責另一款處理器，或是參與OpenAI與三星共同開發的下一代晶片。
三星電子及SK海力士(000660KS) 目前已為OpenAI的「星際之門」（Stargate）資料中心計畫供應記憶體晶片，但記憶體供應與共同開發、製造AI處理器屬於不同合作領域。
從OpenAI目前的說法來看，第一代Jalapeño由台積電量產，因此較難判斷三星是否會成為該晶片的第二供應商。
相較之下，OpenAI此次明確提到的是「下一代晶片」，而Jalapeño後繼產品的研發也已進入後期階段，因此三星未來參與下一代推理論ASIC代工的可能性受到關注。
此外，三星電子與博通今年7月底宣布一項價值超過2,000億美元的策略合作，涵蓋先進晶圓代工、記憶體及封裝技術，合作期限至2030年。
OpenAI此前已與博通達成採購10吉瓦（GW）客製化AI加速器的協議，若未來部分晶片轉由三星製造，理論上可形成台積電與三星雙代工的供應架構，但相關安排仍取決於OpenAI的實際需求及晶片設計。
市場也將OpenAI可能採取的模式與特斯拉(TSLA-US) 做法相提並論。特斯拉計畫將AI5處理器應用於AI資料中心、汽車及Optimus人形機器人等多個高量產場景，因此可能需要台積電與三星分別提供製造產能，以增加供應鏈韌性。
分析稱，對OpenAI而言，若下一代AI加速器採用多裸片設計的大型先進處理器，且需要吉瓦級供應量，單一晶圓代工廠台積電的產能是否足夠，將成為重要考量，可能成為OpenAI尋求第二家代工夥伴的原因之一。
不過，OpenAI目前並未證實將由三星負責製造晶片。OpenAI發言人向《Tom's Hardware》表示，外界所提到的擴大與三星合作，是在雙方既有合作關係的背景下，包括三星電子採用ChatGPT以及去年10月公布的意向書，「我們沒有新的消息可以公布」，並強調公司「並未宣布透過三星製造晶片的計畫」。
paras_en: OpenAI's partnership with Samsung Electronics (005930KS) may expand beyond memory supply and enterprise AI services to include AI chip manufacturing.

According to Reuters, OpenAI Korea General Manager Harrison Kim said at a press conference in Seoul this week that the two sides have made significant progress on "joint production and research" of next‑generation chips, sparking talk that OpenAI may seek Samsung to foundry AI processors.

Kim said, "One of the areas where we have made the greatest progress and received the most recognition in our collaboration with Samsung is the joint production and research of the next‑generation chip we are developing," but he gave no further details.
OpenAI has already launched its own AI‑specific ASIC program and is working with Broadcom (AVGO-US) on chip design, while TSMC (2330‑TW) provides wafer fabrication and advanced packaging services.
OpenAI previously introduced its first inference AI accelerator, Jalapeño, which went from chip definition and co‑design with Broadcom to TSMC manufacturing in under 18 months.

However, it remains unclear whether Samsung, if added to OpenAI's chip supply chain, would serve as a second foundry source for Jalapeño, handle a different processor, or participate in jointly developing the next‑generation chip with Samsung.

Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix (000660KS) currently supply memory chips for OpenAI's "Stargate" data‑center project, but memory supply and joint AI‑processor development/manufacturing are separate cooperation areas.
From OpenAI's statements, the first‑generation Jalapeño is mass‑produced by TSMC, making it difficult to determine if Samsung will become a second supplier for that chip.

In contrast, OpenAI specifically mentioned a "next‑generation chip," and development of Jalapeño's successor is already in its later stages, drawing attention to Samsung's potential role in foundrying the next‑gen inference ASIC.

Additionally, Samsung and Broadcom announced at the end of July a strategic partnership worth over $200 billion covering advanced wafer foundry, memory and packaging technologies, lasting through 2030.

OpenAI previously signed a deal with Broadcom to procure 10 GW of custom AI accelerators; if some chips later shift to Samsung production, a dual‑foundry supply structure with TSMC and Samsung could theoretically emerge, though arrangements depend on OpenAI's actual needs and chip designs.

The market also likens OpenAI's possible approach to Tesla's (TSLA-US) strategy. Tesla plans to use its AI‑5 processor across AI data centers, vehicles and the Optimus humanoid robot, potentially requiring both TSMC and Samsung to provide manufacturing capacity to boost supply‑chain resilience.

Analysts note that if OpenAI's next‑generation AI accelerator adopts a large, multi‑die advanced processor requiring gigawatt‑scale supply, a single foundry like TSMC may not have sufficient capacity, which could drive OpenAI to seek a second foundry partner.

However, OpenAI has not confirmed Samsung will manufacture its chips. A spokesperson told Tom's Hardware that the rumored expansion of cooperation with Samsung is within the context of existing ties—including Samsung's use of ChatGPT and a letter of intent announced in October—stating "we have no new news to announce" and emphasizing the company has not announced any plan to make chips through Samsung.

items.title: Anthropic、OpenAI、Google 傳討論合作成立AI產業標準機構
items.title_en: Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google Discuss Cooperating to Set Up an AI Industry Standards Body
paras: 據《The Information》報導，知情人士透露，Anthropic、OpenAI和Google已經在討論合作成立一個人工智慧（AI）產業標準機構。
在Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei上周六（12日）呼籲人工智慧公司在技術測試和審核方面進行協調之前，相關磋商就已經開始。
Anthropic、OpenAI和Google圍繞這一由產業主導的標準機構舉行的工作組會議仍在繼續。
OpenAI執行長Sam Altman在一次員工大會上表示，他支持成立一個面向人工智慧產業的測試和審核機構。
但他也認為，在沒有美國政府支持的情況下，主要人工智慧實驗室必須自行成立一個標準機構。
paras_en: According to a report by The Information, sources familiar with the matter say Anthropic, OpenAI and Google are already in talks about cooperating to create an industry standards body for artificial intelligence (AI).
The discussions began before Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called on AI companies last Saturday (the 12th) to coordinate on technical testing and review.
Working‑group meetings among Anthropic, OpenAI and Google on this industry‑led standards body are still ongoing.
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said at an all‑hands meeting that he supports the creation of a testing and review body for the AI industry.
However, he also believes that without backing from the U.S. government, the major AI labs will have to set up a standards body on their own.

items.title: 川普稱美國可能留在伊朗「保留石油」！伊朗戰爭料「年底前」結束
items.title_en: Trump Says the U.S. Might Remain in Iran and "Retain Oil"! Iran War Expected to End "Before Year‑End"
paras: 美國總統川普週日（13日）表示，美國可能留在伊朗並「保留石油」，並將此與美國推動掌控委內瑞拉龐大石油儲量五分之一的行動相提並論。
根據《路透》報導，川普在前往愛爾蘭參加會議並觀看高爾夫賽事期間重申，他仍預期伊朗戰爭將在今年結束，時間可能就在11月美國期中選舉結束後不久。
川普在愛爾蘭公開賽高爾夫錦標賽期間表示，一旦伊朗戰爭結束，汽油價格將「像石頭一樣暴跌」。
中東局勢動盪已持續衝擊國際原油市場。沙烏地阿拉伯一條輸油管線遭到攻擊後，原油交易商預期油價週一可能再次走高。
川普表示，美國只會達成「正確的協議」，不會接受「不好的協議」。他並稱伊朗「一直在打電話」要求進行和平談判，但德黑蘭過去曾否認這項說法。
不過，川普同時提出另一種可能性，即美國繼續與伊朗保持接觸，並指出美國8月宣布的委內瑞拉協議作為對照。
川普表示：「我們最終會離開伊朗，除非我們決定留下來，像委內瑞拉一樣保留石油。」他並補充，美國從委內瑞拉取得的收入「已經多次支付戰爭的成本」。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Sunday (the 13th) that the United States might stay in Iran and "retain oil," likening this to the U.S. push to control one‑fifth of Venezuela’s massive oil reserves.

According to Reuters, Trump reiterated during a trip to Ireland for a conference and a golf tournament that he still expects the war with Iran to end this year, possibly shortly after the U.S. mid‑term elections in November.
Speaking at the Irish Open golf championship, Trump said that once the Iran war is over, gasoline prices will "plummet like a stone."
Turbulence in the Middle East has continued to weigh on the global crude market. After a Saudi Arabian oil pipeline was attacked, oil traders expected prices could rise again on Monday.
Trump said the United States will only strike a "right agreement" and will not accept a "bad agreement." He added that Iran has "kept calling" for peace talks, a claim Tehran has previously denied.
However, Trump also floated another possibility—that the United States could keep engaging with Iran—and pointed to the Venezuela deal announced by the U.S. in August as a comparison.

Trump said, "We will eventually leave Iran unless we decide to stay, retaining oil like we did in Venezuela," and added that the revenue the U.S. has taken from Venezuela "has already paid for the war many times over."

items.title: 南韓半導體出口暴增209%，ICT出口逼近600億美元創新高
items.title_en: South Korea's Semiconductor Exports Surge 209%, ICT Exports Near $60 Billion Hit Record High
paras: 2026年09月14日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 南韓8月資訊通信科技(ICT)出口達599.8億美元，較去年同期的228.4億美元增加162.6%，連續三個月超過500億美元，改寫單月歷史新高。
根據南韓科學技術資訊通信部與產業通商資源部公布的ICT進出口資料，8月ICT出口占南韓整體出口982.5億美元的61%，占比首度突破六成。
主要出口品項中，半導體出口年增209%，連續三個月超過400億美元；電腦與周邊設備出口年增383.1%，包括中大型電腦、零組件及企業級固態硬碟(SSD)出口均增加。
手機出口年增23.2%，通訊設備出口年增11.5%。顯示器出口則年減7%，主要受到手機用有機發光二極體(OLED)面板價格下滑影響，為主要品項中唯一衰退項目。
以出口地區來看，對美國出口年增306.5%，對中國及香港出口年增227.9%，對印度、越南、日本、台灣及歐盟出口則分別增加126.7%、81.4%、72.4%、54.3%及49.1%。
南韓8月ICT進口為186.1億美元，較去年同期的125.1億美元增加48.8%。其中，半導體進口年增71.4%，手機年增79.4%，電腦與周邊設備年增39.9%；ICT貿易順差達413.7億美元，首度突破400億美元。

paras_en: September 14, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – South Korea's ICT exports in August reached $59.98 billion, up 162.6% from $22.84 billion a year earlier, marking the third consecutive month above $50 billion and setting a new single‑month record.

According to ICT import‑export data released by South Korea's Ministry of Science and ICT and the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, ICT exports in August accounted for 61% of the country's total exports of $98.25 billion, breaking the 60% threshold for the first time.

Among the main export categories, semiconductor exports jumped 209% year‑on‑year, staying above $40 billion for three straight months; computer and peripheral equipment exports rose 383.1% year‑on‑year, with increases across mid‑ to large‑size computers, components and enterprise‑grade solid‑state drives (SSDs).

Mobile phone exports grew 23.2% year‑on‑year and communications equipment rose 11.5%. Monitor exports fell 7% year‑on‑year, mainly due to a drop in OLED panel prices for smartphones, making it the only declining item among the major categories.

By destination, exports to the United States surged 306.5% year‑on‑year, to China and Hong Kong rose 227.9%, and shipments to India, Vietnam, Japan, Taiwan and the EU increased by 126.7%, 81.4%, 72.4%, 54.3% and 49.1% respectively.

South Korea's ICT imports in August were $18.61 billion, up 48.8% from $12.51 billion a year earlier. Semiconductor imports rose 71.4%, mobile phones 79.4%, and computer and peripheral equipment 39.9%; the ICT trade surplus reached $41.37 billion, surpassing $40 billion for the first time.
