items.title: AI行為準則今公布！微軟執行長納德拉：支持AI審慎發展與嵌入式評估機制
items.title_en: AI Code of Conduct Unveiled Today! Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella: Supports Prudent AI Development and Embedded Evaluation Mechanisms
paras: 微軟執行長納德拉週(13)日在X平台上發文談及微軟的先進AI發展理念，認為任何對超級智慧的探索都必須在核心原則約束下運作。如果人們建構的AI無法幫助人類，無法被人類控制，就不值得發展。
但他認為，AI需要加速發展，使其成果能廣泛傳播，並惠及不同國家、社區和企業。這顯然需要建立前沿生態，讓開源和閉源模型都能蓬勃發展。對企業來說，這意味著他們必須完全掌握自身獨有的隱性知識。每家公司都應該可以建構屬於自己的、持續學習循環、不斷迭代的系統，而不必依賴單一模型供應商，還應將自身知識融入模型中。
在此背景下，納德拉表示，他歡迎必要的研究、關注和有意識的推進節奏，以確保「對齊」成為設計目標。
他也歡迎「嵌入式評估器」等概念，以及更廣泛的努力，推動建立相關機制，讓這些理念不只是停留在口語層面。
納德拉還強調，這一領域不能由少數幾個實體控制，必須讓整個生態系統、不同國家和各個領域，包括學術界，都廣泛參與其中。
他同時表示，微軟的方案是在AI技術堆疊的每一層提供廣泛存取權限與選擇，以及支撐微軟自研MAI模型的《行為準則》。該準則將於週一(13日)發布，公開徵求意見。
paras_en: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella posted on X on Tuesday (the 13th) about the company’s advanced AI development philosophy, stating that any exploration of superintelligence must operate under core principles. If the AI we build cannot help humanity or be controlled by humans, it is not worth developing.

He added that AI needs to accelerate so its benefits can be widely disseminated and reach different countries, communities and businesses. This clearly requires building a frontier ecosystem where both open‑source and closed‑source models can thrive. For enterprises, this means they must fully own their proprietary tacit knowledge. Each company should be able to build its own continuously learning, iterating system without relying on a single model vendor, and embed its own knowledge into the models.
In this context, Nadella said he welcomes necessary research, attention and a conscious pace of progress to ensure that “alignment” becomes a design goal.
He also welcomed concepts such as “embedded evaluators” and broader efforts to establish mechanisms that move these ideas beyond mere rhetoric.
Nadella emphasized that this field must not be controlled by a few entities; the entire ecosystem, different nations and sectors—including academia—must be broadly involved.

He added that Microsoft’s approach is to provide broad access and choice at every layer of the AI technology stack, and to support Microsoft’s internally developed MAI model with a “Code of Conduct.” The code will be released on Monday the 13th for public comment.

items.title: Anthropic傳選定那斯達克上市！最快10月IPO、募資規模上看超越SpaceX
items.title_en: Anthropic Chooses Nasdaq for Listing! IPO as Early as October, Fundraising Size May Surpass SpaceX
paras: 知情人士透露，Anthropic已選定那斯達克（Nasdaq）作為潛在首次公開募股（IPO）的上市地點，若最終成行，這家Claude聊天機器人開發商的上市規模可能刷新紀錄。
根據《彭博》報導，知情人士表示，Anthropic尋求透過IPO募資的金額，可能達到或超過SpaceX(SPCX-US) 的規模，這宗IPO最快可能在10月進行。
若Anthropic在那斯達克掛牌，將是該交易所今年的又一項勝利。今年美國規模最大的4宗IPO均在那斯達克進行，其中包括SpaceX於6月創下紀錄的863億美元IPO。
數週後，SK海力士（SK Hynix Inc.）也在7月上市，募得265億美元。《Business Insider》先前已報導Anthropic選擇那斯達克的消息。
Anthropic積極籌備上市之際，人工智慧（AI）產業的快速發展與潛在風險也成為業界高層近期關注焦點。
OpenAI執行長Sam Altman、Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei及馬斯週六（12日）均表示，隨著AI技術帶來的風險升高，有必要放慢AI發展速度。
Altman接受《財富》訪問時則表示，OpenAI今年不會上市，理由與安全疑慮有關。
此外，《彭博》此前報導，Anthropic本月稍早原定敲定一筆150億美元的循環信用額度。
AI競賽升溫也帶動美國IPO市場復甦。根據《彭博》彙整數據，今年美國IPO募資總額已達1,606億美元，不包括特殊目的收購公司（SPAC）及其他金融工具，創下2021年以來單年度最高紀錄。
Anthropic本身的營收成長也十分迅速。按照目前業績表現推算，Anthropic年化營收已突破650億美元，較去年底的年化營收速度增加逾7倍。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Insiders say Anthropic has selected Nasdaq as the venue for its potential initial public offering, and if it goes ahead, the Claude chatbot developer could set a record with the size of its listing.
According to Bloomberg, sources indicate Anthropic is aiming to raise an amount through the IPO that could match or exceed SpaceX (SPCX-US), with the offering possibly occurring as early as October.
If Anthropic lists on Nasdaq, it will be another win for the exchange this year. The four largest U.S. IPOs this year were all on Nasdaq, including SpaceX's record‑breaking $86.3 billion IPO in June.
Weeks later, SK Hynix also went public in July, raising $26.5 billion. Business Insider had previously reported Anthropic's choice of Nasdaq.
As Anthropic prepares for a listing, the rapid growth and potential risks of the AI industry have become a focus for senior executives.
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and Elon Musk on Saturday (the 12th) all said that rising AI‑related risks make it necessary to slow the pace of AI development.
Altman told Fortune that OpenAI will not go public this year, citing safety concerns.
Bloomberg also reported earlier this month that Anthropic had planned to secure a $15 billion revolving credit facility.

The heated AI competition is reviving the U.S. IPO market. Bloomberg data show that total U.S. IPO proceeds this year have reached $160.6 billion, excluding SPACs and other instruments, the highest annual total since 2021.
Anthropic's revenue growth is also rapid. Based on current performance, its annualized revenue has already exceeded $65 billion, more than seven times the annualized rate at the end of last year.
(This article is not available for partner re‑publication)

items.title: 網路泡沫既視感重現！債息油價齊飆　華爾街老將：今年像90年代末 但未到離場時
items.title_en: Internet Bubble Déjà Vu Returns! Yields and Oil Prices Surge — Wall Street Veteran: This Year Feels Like Late 1990s, But It's Not Time to Exit
paras: 美債殖利率飆升與油價暴漲，令華爾街老將聯想到網路泡沫破滅前的氛圍，但他們認為，這還不足以成為離場理由。
當前股市面臨多重逆風，10年期美債殖利率逼近5%，長債殖利率接近2007年以來高位；西德州中質原油(WTI)價格徘徊在每桶100美元附近，美伊戰爭持續推高能源價格，交易員押注聯準會(Fed)本周將升息應對頑固通膨，加上9月向來為股市弱勢表現月份，看似是拋售時機。標普500指數自6月初以來幾乎原地踏步，此前五個月累計上漲11%，且連三年呈雙位數漲幅表現。
即便如此，在通膨數據提升升息機率下，美股上週五(11日)仍走漲，投資者逢低買入。
Roundhill Investments首席投資策略師Drew Pettit表示：「股市就像一隻鴨子，表面風平浪靜，水下卻在拼命划動雙腳。」
市場將當前與1990年代末比較並非無理，美銀與CIBC資本市場策略師指出，科技股曾在Fed升息周期及美債殖利率上升環境中維持上漲數年，最終才迎來泡沫破裂。
Angeles Investment Advisors首席投資官Michael Rosen則表示，更大風險在於錯過牛市最後一段行情，因為這階段通常回報最為豐厚。
Rosemn並非預言牛市結束，但若真結束，先錯過上漲再試圖重新進場幾乎不可能。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury yields are soaring and oil prices are spiking, reminding Wall Street veterans of the atmosphere before the dot‑com bubble burst, but they say that alone is not enough reason to get out of the market.

The equity market currently faces multiple headwinds: the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield is nearing 5%, long‑term yields are close to their highest levels since 2007; West Texas Intermediate crude is hovering around $100 a barrel, with the ongoing Israel‑Iran conflict pushing energy prices higher. Traders are betting the Fed will raise rates this week to combat stubborn inflation, and September has traditionally been a weak month for stocks, making it seem like a selling opportunity. The S&P 500 has been essentially flat since early June, after gaining 11% over the prior five months and delivering double‑digit annual returns for three consecutive years.
Nevertheless, with inflation data increasing the odds of another rate hike, U.S. equities still rose last Friday (the 11th), as investors bought on dips.
Drew Pettit, chief investment strategist at Roundhill Investments, said: “The stock market is like a duck – calm on the surface while frantically paddling underneath.”

Comparing the current environment to the late 1990s is not unreasonable; strategists at Bank of America and CIBC’s capital markets noted that tech stocks managed to climb for several years during Fed‑tightening cycles and rising Treasury yields before the bubble finally burst.
Michael Rosen, chief investment officer at Angeles Investment Advisors, warned that the bigger risk is missing the final leg of the bull market, which typically delivers the richest returns.
Rosemn is not predicting the end of the bull market, but if it does end, missing the rally and then trying to re‑enter would be virtually impossible.

items.title: 哈塞特：：川普「100%尊重」聯準會獨立性、通膨降溫沒必要升息
items.title_en: Hassett: Trump “100% respects” Fed independence, no need to raise rates as inflation cools
paras: 白宮國家經濟委員會主任哈塞特（Kevin Hassett）表示，川普政府將支持聯準會即將作出的利率決策，即使他認為近期通膨數據並不足以支持再次升息。此外，美國政府官員本週也準備討論人工智慧（AI）可能的安全防護措施，此前Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei已針對AI快速發展帶來的風險提出警告。
哈塞特週日（13日）接受《CNN》訪問時表示，美國總統川普「100%尊重」聯準會主席華許（Kevin Warsh）的獨立性，無論央行本週作出何種決定，政府都會接受。
不過，哈塞特也表示，他與川普都認為目前不應升息。他指出，過去3個月通膨已有放緩跡象，近期數據呈現的情況比12個月期數據更加令人鼓舞。
美國勞工統計局數據顯示，8月消費者物價指數（CPI）年增3.4%，較7月上升0.4%；排除食品與能源價格的核心通膨則年增2.4%。
哈塞特將先前部分通膨壓力歸因於波斯灣衝突期間油價飆升。他也指出，聯準會過去通常不願在選舉前不久調整利率，原因是希望維護央行的政治獨立性。
對投資人而言，哈塞特的說法代表，即使聯準會作出不符合白宮期待的決定，白宮目前並無意立即挑戰央行決策。不過，川普持續公開要求降息，仍可能讓市場持續關注聯準會獨立性，並影響債券、匯率及對利率敏感的股票。
哈塞特也緩和了川普先前發出的威脅，即如果聯準會不降息，將停止與對美擁有貿易順差國家的貿易往來。
哈塞特表示：「我不認為貿易會降到零。」他認為，川普的說法主要是在表達其強烈希望降低借貸成本的立場。
如果美國全面暫停與中國、加拿大、墨西哥、德國及日本等國的貿易，將擾亂供應鏈，並可能推高美國消費者與企業面臨的價格。
哈塞特的回應顯示，政府不太可能按字面執行這項威脅。

白宮本週討論AI安全監管

在AI議題方面，哈塞特駁斥科技業高層的警告必然導致市場動盪的說法。
他形容Amodei近期提出的方案具有思考價值，並表示政府將研究相關建議。Amodei主張，AI開發商應放慢更強大AI系統的推出速度，讓安全措施有時間跟上；他也建議讓獨立評估機構能更廣泛取得AI企業開發工作的資訊。其他科技業領袖，包括馬斯克與OpenAI執行長Sam Altman也支持加強AI安全措施。
哈塞特表示，白宮科技及網路安全官員預計本週開會，討論可能建立的防護措施。川普此前表示願意採取部分保護措施，但同時警告，過度限制可能削弱美國與中國競爭的能力。
根據《路透》報導，川普仍持續強調要維持美國在先進AI領域的領先地位。
哈塞特指出，政府必須處理AI代理執行網路攻擊的風險，同時避免監管速度過快，導致敵對國家或組織反而開發出更先進的系統。
他表示，更大的風險是「惡意行為者取得比我們更先進的AI」，進而可能利用先進模型開發生物武器。
對科技投資人而言，AI政策討論也帶來雙重影響。一方面，獨立監控及新的安全標準可能提高AI開發商的合規成本；另一方面，適度的聯邦監管架構也可能降低政策不確定性，並提升市場對AI產業的信心。
paras_en: White House National Economic Council director Kevin Hassett said the Trump administration will back the Federal Reserve’s upcoming rate decision even though he believes recent inflation data do not justify another hike. This week U.S. officials are also set to discuss possible safety safeguards for artificial intelligence (AI) after Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei warned of risks from rapid AI development.

In a Sunday (the 13th) interview with CNN, Hassett said President Trump “100% respects” Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s independence and that the government will accept whatever decision the central bank makes this week.

However, Hassett also said both he and Trump think rates should not be raised now. He noted that inflation has shown signs of slowing over the past three months and that recent data are more encouraging than the 12‑month figures.
U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics data show the August Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 3.4% year‑over‑year, up 0.4% from July; core inflation, which excludes food and energy, rose 2.4% year‑over‑year.

Hassett attributed part of the earlier inflation pressure to the oil‑price surge during the Gulf conflict. He also pointed out that the Fed historically avoids adjusting rates shortly before an election to preserve its political independence.

For investors, Hassett’s comments signal that even if the Fed makes a decision that falls short of White House expectations, the administration does not intend to immediately challenge the central bank. Yet Trump’s continued public calls for rate cuts could keep market focus on Fed independence and affect bonds, currencies and rate‑sensitive stocks.
Hassett also softened Trump’s earlier threat to halt trade with countries that run a trade surplus with the United States if the Fed does not cut rates.
Hassett said, “I don’t think trade would go to zero.” He believes Trump’s statement mainly expresses a strong desire to lower borrowing costs.

If the United States were to completely stop trade with China, Canada, Mexico, Germany, Japan and other nations, supply chains would be disrupted and could push up prices faced by U.S. consumers and businesses.
Hassett’s response shows the government is unlikely to implement that threat literally.
The White House will discuss AI safety regulation this week. On AI, Hassett rejected the notion that warnings from tech executives necessarily lead to market turmoil.

He described Amodei’s recent proposals as worth considering and said the government will study the suggestions. Amodei argues AI developers should slow the rollout of more powerful systems so safety measures can keep pace, and that independent assessors should have broader access to information on AI development work. Other tech leaders, including Elon Musk and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, also back stronger AI safety measures.

Hassett said White House technology and cybersecurity officials expect to meet this week to discuss possible protective measures. Trump previously said he was willing to adopt some safeguards but warned that excessive restrictions could weaken the United States’ competitive edge against China.
According to Reuters, Trump continues to stress the need to keep the United States ahead in advanced AI.

Hassett noted the government must address the risk of AI agents conducting cyber‑attacks while avoiding overly rapid regulation that could push hostile nations or groups to develop even more advanced systems.
He warned the bigger risk is “malicious actors obtaining AI that is more advanced than ours,” which could be used to develop biological weapons.

For tech investors, the AI policy debate has a dual impact: on one hand, independent monitoring and new safety standards could raise compliance costs for AI developers; on the other, a measured federal regulatory framework could reduce policy uncertainty and boost confidence in the AI industry.

items.title: 蘇姿丰賭Agentic AI贏了！AMD超越高通成全球第三大晶片設計廠 輝達穩居冠、聯發科第五
items.title_en: Su Zifeng’s Bet on Agentic AI Pays Off! AMD Overtakes Qualcomm to Become the World’s Third‑Largest Chip Designer, Nvidia Stays on Top, MediaTek Fifth
paras: 根據TrendForce(集邦咨詢)最新研究報告，今年第二季全球前十大無晶圓廠IC設計合計營收1414.5億美元，年增73%，AI GPU、CPU、ASIC與高速互連需求主導排名重洗，最大變動是超微(AMD)以115.3億美元超越高通、升至第三。
AI晶片大廠輝達穩居榜首，今年Q2營收近911.6億美元、年增99%，占前十大64%，客戶由雲端巨頭擴至新雲廠(Neo Cloud)、主權AI與企業端，博通則以營收188.9億美元次之，年增率112%，主要受惠於OpenAI首款ASIC、谷歌TPU 8i出貨及XPU網通需求。
超微則受Agentic AI拉抬CPU戰略價值，資料中心CPU連五季創高，持續蠶食X86伺服器份額，高通則被超微擠到第四、營收逾85億美元，新一代iPhone基頻供應份額下滑，但車用晶片連23季雙位數增長，近期重返資料中心、加速QCT多元化。
台灣廠商聯發科約48.1億美元排第五，手機業務承壓，該公司上調AI ASIC展望，預估2026年資料中心營收逾20億美元，2028年ASIC可服務市場升至800億美元。
整體來看，AI算力正把無晶圓設計格局由手機消費驅動，改寫為資料中心、客製晶片與互連並進。
paras_en: According to TrendForce’s latest research report, the combined revenue of the world’s top ten fabless IC designers in Q2 of this year reached $141.45 billion, up 73% year‑over‑year, driven by demand for AI GPUs, CPUs, ASICs and high‑speed interconnects that reshuffled the rankings. The biggest change was AMD, with $11.53 billion in revenue, overtaking Qualcomm to climb to third place.

AI chip giant Nvidia remained at the top of the list, posting Q2 revenue of about $91.16 billion, a 99% year‑over‑year increase, accounting for 64% of the top ten’s total. Its customer base expanded from cloud giants to new cloud players (Neo Cloud), sovereign AI projects and enterprise customers. Broadcom came in second with $18.89 billion in revenue, up 112% year‑over‑year, boosted by the first OpenAI ASIC, Google’s TPU 8i shipments and XPU networking demand.

AMD’s rise was fueled by the strategic value of Agentic AI for its CPUs, with data‑center CPU sales hitting a five‑quarter high and continuing to eat into the x86 server market share. Qualcomm was pushed down to fourth with revenue just over $8.5 billion; its share of next‑generation iPhone baseband supply fell, though its automotive chip business posted double‑digit growth for 23 consecutive quarters and it is recently re‑entering data‑center and accelerating QCT diversification.

Taiwan’s MediaTek posted roughly $4.81 billion in revenue, ranking fifth. Its handset business is under pressure, but the company raised its AI ASIC outlook, forecasting data‑center revenue of more than $2 billion by 2026 and an ASIC‑serviceable market of $80 billion by 2028.
Overall, AI compute power is shifting the fabless design landscape away from being driven by mobile consumer demand toward a mix of data‑center, custom chips and interconnect solutions.

items.title: 加拿大總理將訪歐 尋求歐盟「準成員國」特殊地位
items.title_en: Canadian Prime Minister to Visit Europe Seeking EU “Quasi‑Member” Special Status
paras: 加拿大總理卡尼將於9月15日至17日訪問法國斯特拉斯堡和英國利物浦，尋求進一步加強與歐洲的關係，據美國方面13日消息，卡尼此行尋求加拿大獲得歐盟「準成員國」特殊地位。
歐盟和加拿大官員稱，歐盟對給予加拿大「準成員國」地位的想法持開放態度。「準成員國」這一設想今年早些時候由德國總理梅爾茨提出，該設想最初主要針對烏克蘭。
按照梅爾茨的設想，在烏克蘭成為歐盟正式成員國之前，允許其以過渡形式參與歐盟會議和機關運作，但不擁有投票權。
分析人士表示，目前歐盟並沒有「準成員國」這一正式類別，加拿大若尋求獲得這一地位，恐面臨一系列障礙。
儘管如此，歐美之間不斷加劇的貿易和地緣政治摩擦，很可能促使歐盟考慮以更加靈活方式與加拿大建立深層次合作關係。
paras_en: Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau will travel to Strasbourg, France, and Liverpool, United Kingdom, from September 15‑17, seeking to further strengthen ties with Europe, according to a U.S. source on the 13th. Trudeau’s trip aims to secure a special “quasi‑member” status for Canada within the EU.

EU and Canadian officials say the EU is open to the idea of granting Canada a “quasi‑member” status. The concept was first floated earlier this year by German Chancellor Olaf Scholz and was initially aimed primarily at Ukraine.
Under Scholz’s proposal, Ukraine would be allowed to participate in EU meetings and institutions in a transitional capacity before becoming a full member, but without voting rights.
Analysts note that the EU currently has no formal “quasi‑member” category, and Canada’s bid for such a status could face a range of obstacles.
Nevertheless, the growing trade and geopolitical frictions between Europe and the United States are likely to push the EU to consider a more flexible, deeper cooperation framework with Canada.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】美國CPI上漲，推動美元走強
items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: US CPI Rise Fuels Strong Dollar
paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國8月最終需求生產者物價指數(PPI)分別較前月與上年同期漲0.4%及5.4%，初請失業金人數則降至20.6萬人，同時中東局勢無緩解跡象，導致油價飆升，加劇通貨膨脹擔憂，強化美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)本周加息的預期，但上週五日本央行(BOJ)公布日本8月國內企業物價指數(CGPI)較前月跌0.2%，可是較去年同期升7.6%超過估值，另外日本第三季大型製造業景氣判斷指數升至正7.6，鞏固BOJ本月加息理據，而且日本財務大臣片山皋月表示政府繼續與美國密切溝通，確保外匯市場有序運行，並稱與美國實施聯合干預及發表聯合聲明以來政策立場未變，激勵日圓上漲，美元兌日圓自154.61高點走跌。

據路透調查，日本8月核心消費者通貨膨脹率持穩，而且消息人士透露，BOJ本周可能加息25個基點，若通貨膨脹超標風險加劇，可能釋放加快收緊貨幣政策信號，擴大日圓漲幅；此外，美國8月消費者物價指數(CPI)分別較前月與上年同期升0.4%及3.4%符合預期，核心CPI則較去年同期降至2.4%，但較前月漲0.3%高於估值，促使芝加哥商業交易所（CME）FedWatch工具顯示，FED升息機率升至91%，並據美國密西根大學調查消費者一年與五年通貨膨脹預期分別升至4.6%及3.4%，但9月消費者信心指數驟降至47.8，打擊美元兌日圓至153.23低點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於153.70-90，支撐於152.70-90。
◆EUR/USD
金屬價格大跌及避險情緒拖累風險資產，上週五令澳幣和紐元承壓，但通貨膨脹可能更長時間維持高位，預計澳洲央行(RBA)本月升息的概率達90%，並據消息人士及歐洲央行(ECB)管理委員會委員納格爾分別表示，若能源價格上漲趨勢持續，ECB決策者未來數月可能需要再收緊政策，利率升至溫和限制性區間，支撐歐元兌美元徘徊於1.1617高點。

隨後法國央行(BOF)總裁穆蘭稱，法國經濟未面臨災難性風險，但政府必須採取行動削減公共財政赤字，並據法國回聲報報導，政府將下調今年經濟增長至約0.5%，而且ECB管理委員會委員馬赫盧夫認為持續不斷的中東衝突可能導致通貨膨脹在較長時間內維持高位，若ECB進一步大幅升息，可能對經濟增長造成損害，推低歐元兌美元匯價至1.1568低點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1580-1.1600，支撐於1.1500-20。
◆GBP/USD

上週五英國7月數據顯示，工業生產與製造業產出分別較上年同期升0.6%及2.6%，國內生產總值(GDP)則分別較前月與去年同期增長0.4%及1.6%，均優於預期，但英國民眾通貨膨脹預期在8月大幅下降，未來一年、兩年與五年預期分別降至3.2%、2.9%及3.2%，打壓英鎊兌美元至1.3479低點。隨後英國央行(BOE)預計本周維持利率不變，但市場幾乎已完全消化11月升息的預期，更預計到2027年年中將再加息約三次，扶助英鎊兌美元回升至1.3534高點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3515-35，支撐於1.3430-50。

US August final demand producer price index (PPI) rose 0.4% month‑over‑month and 5.4% year‑over‑year, initial jobless claims fell to 206,000. At the same time, Middle‑East tensions showed no sign of easing, pushing oil prices higher and heightening inflation concerns, which bolsters expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise rates this week. Last Friday, however, the Bank of Japan (BOJ) reported Japan’s August corporate goods price index (CGPI) fell 0.2% from the prior month but was up 7.6% from a year ago, beating forecasts. Japan’s Q3 large‑manufacturing business confidence index rose to +7.6, reinforcing the BOJ’s case for a rate hike this month. Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki said the government continues close communication with the United States to ensure orderly FX markets and noted that the policy stance has not changed since the joint intervention and statement with the US, encouraging yen gains as the dollar‑yen pair fell from a high of 154.61.

According to a Reuters poll, Japan’s August core consumer inflation held steady, and sources say the BOJ could raise rates by 25 basis points this week. If inflation risks intensify, the BOJ may signal a faster tightening cycle, further boosting the yen. In the US, August CPI rose 0.4% month‑over‑month and 3.4% year‑over‑year, in line with expectations, while core CPI fell to 2.4% year‑over‑year but rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, above forecasts. This pushed the CME FedWatch tool to show a 91% probability of a Fed hike. A University of Michigan survey showed one‑year and five‑year inflation expectations climbing to 4.6% and 3.4%, but the September consumer confidence index dropped sharply to 47.8, pulling the dollar‑yen down to a low of 153.23. The dollar‑yen resistance today is estimated at 153.70‑90, support at 152.70‑90.
EUR/USD

Metal price crashes and risk‑off sentiment weighed on risk assets last Friday, pressuring the Australian and New Zealand dollars. Yet inflation may stay elevated for longer, prompting a 90% probability that the Reserve Bank of Australia will raise rates this month. Sources and ECB Governing Council member Nagel said that if energy price rises persist, ECB policymakers may need to tighten further in the coming months, moving rates into a mildly restrictive band and supporting the euro near its high of 1.1617 against the dollar.

Subsequently, French central bank (Banque de France) governor François Villeroy de Galhau said France’s economy does not face catastrophic risk, but the government must act to cut the fiscal deficit. According to Le Figaro, the government will lower this year’s growth forecast to about 0.5%. ECB Governing Council member Makhlouf warned that ongoing Middle‑East conflict could keep inflation high for an extended period, and a further large rate hike by the ECB could damage growth, pushing the euro‑dollar down to a low of 1.1568. The euro‑dollar resistance today is estimated at 1.1580‑1.1600, support at 1.1500‑1.1520.

Last Friday UK July data showed industrial production and manufacturing output rose 0.6% and 2.6% year‑over‑year, while GDP grew 0.4% month‑over‑month and 1.6% year‑over‑year, both beating expectations. However, UK consumers’ inflation expectations fell sharply in August, with one‑, two‑ and five‑year outlooks dropping to 3.2%, 2.9% and 3.2% respectively, dragging the pound down to a low of 1.3479 against the dollar. The Bank of England is expected to keep rates unchanged this week, with the market having largely priced in a November hike and forecasting about three more hikes by mid‑2027, which could lift the pound back to a high of 1.3534. The pound‑dollar resistance today is estimated at 1.3515‑1.3535, support at 1.3430‑1.3450.

items.title: 車廠兩難！Stellantis執行長：全球車市分化為「美國」與「其他地區」
items.title_en: Car Makers in a Dilemma! Stellantis CEO: Global Auto Market Split into "USA" and "Other Regions"
paras: Stellantis集團執行長Antonio Filosa上週四(10日)在一場分析師會議上指出，當前全球汽車市場已明顯分化為兩部分：美國與世界其他地區。
Stellantis正面臨美歐等地貿易及政策環境日益分化的挑戰，尤其是與中國企業的合作模式差異顯著。
Filosa強調，美國是Stellantis最主要的利潤來源，但當地法規與消費者需求與其他市場截然不同，如何為美國開發車款成為核心難題。因此，Stellantis在美國完全依賴本土工程與研發力量，但在歐洲等其他市場，則選擇與零跑、東風等中國車廠合作。
值得注意的是，這些合作明確表示不涉及面向美國市場的車型規劃。此前，採取類似模式的福特已遭到白宮抨擊。
美國政府官員批評福特與吉利在歐洲成立合資企業，認為此舉是在幫助中國車場擴大全球業務。福特則回應指合作是為了適應新的全球現實，旨在讓業務更精幹、更有效率。
隨著全球汽車產業格局加速重構，個各車廠如何在分化市場中平衡區域策略，將成為產業共同面臨的考驗。
paras_en: Stellantis Group CEO Antonio Filosa said last Thursday (the 10th) at an analyst meeting that the current global automotive market has clearly divided into two parts: the United States and the rest of the world.
Stellantis is facing increasingly divergent trade and policy environments in places like the US and Europe, especially as its cooperation models with Chinese companies differ markedly.

Filosa emphasized that the United States is Stellantis’s biggest profit source, but local regulations and consumer demand are completely different from other markets, making the development of US‑specific models a core challenge. Consequently, Stellantis relies entirely on domestic engineering and R&D in the US, while in Europe and other regions it chooses to partner with Chinese automakers such as Leapmotor and Dongfeng.
It is noteworthy that these partnerships explicitly state they do not involve vehicle planning for the US market. Previously, Ford, which used a similar model, was criticized by the White House.

US officials criticized Ford and Geely for setting up a joint venture in Europe, saying the move helps Chinese automakers expand globally. Ford responded that the cooperation is meant to adapt to a new global reality, aiming to make its business leaner and more efficient.
As the global automotive industry’s structure rapidly reshapes, how each automaker balances regional strategies in a divided market will become a common challenge for the sector.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元上漲 Fed下周升息可能性提高
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Rises as Fed Rate‑Hike Likelihood Increases Next Week
paras: 美元周五(11日)小幅走高，受到消費者通膨報告推升聯準會(Fed)升息預期的提振。但就本周而言，美元變化不大，交易員反而將注意力集中在美國公債殖利率及日元的大幅反彈上。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)0.1%，報99.13。
匯市參與者周五將焦點集中在最新公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)報告。根據美國勞工統計局(BLS)，8月整體CPI與核心CPI月增率分別為0.4%和0.3%，市場原先預期分別為0.4%和0.2%，且兩者均較7月的0.1%和0.2%加快。
以年增率來看，8月整體CPI上升3.4%，與7月持平。核心CPI則從2.5%降至2.4%，兩項數據均符合市場預期。
CPI數據進一步推升聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)下周升息25個基點的可能性。根據CME FedWatch工具，通膨數據公布後，市場預期升息25個基點的機率從數據公布前約69%，大幅升至接近87%。
儘管PPI和CPI都是市場密切關注的通膨指標，但FOMC更重視個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數，將其視為主要通膨衡量指標。PPI和CPI中的部分項目會納入PCE計算，而PCE通膨率已連續65個月高於聯準會長期2%的目標。
在8月CPI公布前，市場對升息的預期已逐步升溫。7月時，3位地區聯準會主席對FOMC維持利率不變的決定提出異議，到了8月底，聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)年度央行年會上發表明顯偏鷹的演說，指出潛在通膨趨勢並未改善。
同時，其他經濟指標也進一步提高貨幣政策收緊的可能性，包括上周大幅優於預期的非農就業報告，以及周四公布、顯示整體通膨加速的8月生產者物價指數(PPI)報告。
此外，美國與伊朗局勢升溫導致近期油價大幅上漲，進一步加劇市場對通膨的擔憂，也增加美國民眾加油的負擔。美國柴油價格周四更首次突破每加侖6美元。
美國債券市場尤其反映出市場對升息預期持續升溫的情況。自聯準會7月利率決策前後，美債市場便陷入拋售，尤其是長天期債券跌勢更加明顯。殖利率隨後大幅攀升，推動美國30年期公債殖利率升至近20年高點，也促使美國財政部提高長天期公債的回購規模。
然而，美國財政部出乎市場預期的干預並未達到預期效果。CPI公布後，美債周五大致持續走弱，10年期美債殖利率最新上升3.2個基點至4.976%，對利率更敏感的2年期殖利率則上升8.8個基點至4.638%。
市場普遍認為，CPI數據成為最後一根稻草，使升息預期明確轉向升息。
Macquarie經濟學主管David Doyle表示，「我們的基本預期仍是聯準會下周升息，而CPI數據公布後，我們對這項判斷的信心進一步提高。在我們看來，在8月強勁的就業報告公布後，除非通膨數據出現偏鴿派的意外，否則維持利率不變的可能性就會降低。儘管數據內部細項顯示，月增核心PCE可能沒有那麼強勁，但整體而言仍足以支持升息25個基點。」
日元創5月初來首度連兩周上漲
日元自上周以來一直是外匯市場焦點。日元周五進一步升值，創下5月初以來首次連續兩周上漲。美元兌日元下跌0.5%至153.72，本周累計下跌1.6%。
日元近期大幅反彈，反映市場愈來愈相信日本銀行(BoJ)總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)及政策委員會將於9月18日升息。
東京周五公布，8月企業物價指數(CGPI)年增7.6%，高於市場預期的7.4%，顯示進口成本飆升正直接傳導至日本國內的生產端通膨壓力。
DBS分析師指出，儘管市場普遍預期日本銀行將升息25個基點，但市場真正關注的將是政策制定者是否釋放出「彈性、取決於經濟數據」的政策路徑訊號，而非承諾快速連續升息。
歐元在ECB升息後周線下跌
歐元兌美元下跌0.1%至1.1597美元，本周累計下跌0.2%。
歐元走弱之際，歐洲央行(ECB)周四將主要政策利率上調25個基點。ECB表示，中東衝突導致能源價格上漲，持續帶來價格壓力。
ECB在聲明中警告，衝突仍在「產生通膨壓力」，通膨率預計將在「一段較長時間內」明顯高於2%的目標。
此外，《彭博社》周四報導，知情人士透露，ECB官員預計將進一步升息，最快可能在下個月。

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Friday (the 11th), buoyed by a consumer‑inflation report that lifted expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike. Over the week, however, the dollar showed little movement, and traders focused instead on U.S. Treasury yields and a sharp rebound in the yen.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, was up 0.1% at 99.13.

FX market participants on Friday centered on the latest Consumer Price Index (CPI) release. According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, August’s overall CPI and core CPI rose 0.4% and 0.3% month‑over‑month, respectively, versus market expectations of 0.4% and 0.2%, and both accelerated from July’s 0.1% and 0.2% gains.
On an annual basis, August’s overall CPI increased 3.4%, unchanged from July. Core CPI slipped from 2.5% to 2.4%, with both figures matching market forecasts.

The CPI data further boosted the probability that the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) will raise rates by 25 basis points next week. The CME FedWatch tool shows the odds of a 25‑bp hike jumping from roughly 69% before the data to nearly 87% after the release.

Although both the PPI and CPI are closely watched inflation gauges, the FOMC places greater emphasis on the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index as its primary inflation measure. Some items from the PPI and CPI feed into the PCE calculation, and the PCE inflation rate has now been above the Fed’s 2% long‑run target for 65 consecutive months.

Even before the August CPI was released, market expectations for a rate hike were warming. In July, three regional Fed presidents voiced dissent against keeping rates unchanged, and by the end of August, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh delivered a decidedly hawkish speech at the Jackson Hole annual central‑bank meeting, noting that underlying inflation trends had not improved.

At the same time, other economic indicators further raised the likelihood of tighter monetary policy, including last week’s non‑farm payrolls that far exceeded expectations and Thursday’s August Producer Price Index (PPI) report, which showed an acceleration in overall inflation.

In addition, heightened tensions between the United States and Iran have pushed oil prices sharply higher, intensifying inflation concerns and increasing the cost of fueling for Americans. U.S. diesel prices broke the $6‑per‑gallon mark for the first time on Thursday.

The U.S. bond market especially reflected the growing rate‑hike expectations. Since the Fed’s July rate decision, Treasury markets entered a sell‑off, with long‑dated bonds falling the most. Yields then surged, lifting the 30‑year Treasury yield to near a 20‑year high and prompting the Treasury to expand its long‑term bond buy‑back program.

However, the Treasury’s unexpected intervention did not achieve the desired effect. After the CPI release, Treasuries continued to weaken on Friday, with the 10‑year yield rising 3.2 basis points to 4.976% and the more rate‑sensitive 2‑year yield climbing 8.8 basis points to 4.638%.
The market broadly views the CPI data as the final straw that turned rate‑hike expectations decisively upward.

Macquarie chief economist David Doyle said, “Our baseline view remains that the Fed will raise rates next week, and the CPI release has increased our confidence in that judgment. In our view, after the strong August jobs report, unless inflation data surprise on the dovish side, the odds of a hold diminish. While some components of the data suggest core PCE may not be as strong, overall it still supports a 25‑bp hike.”
The yen posted its first consecutive two‑week rise since early May.

The yen has been a focal point in the FX market since last week. On Friday it appreciated further, marking the first back‑to‑back weekly gains since early May. The dollar fell 0.5% against the yen to 153.72, down 1.6% for the week.
The yen’s recent sharp rebound reflects growing market belief that Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda and the policy board will raise rates on September 18.

Tokyo reported on Friday that August’s Corporate Goods Price Index (CGPI) rose 7.6% year‑over‑year, above the 7.4% consensus, indicating that soaring import costs are directly feeding domestic production‑side inflation pressure.

DBS analysts noted that although the market broadly expects a 25‑bp rate hike from the BOJ, the real focus will be on whether policymakers signal a “flexible, data‑dependent” policy path rather than committing to rapid, consecutive hikes.
The euro fell on the weekly chart after the ECB’s rate hike.
The euro slipped 0.1% against the dollar to $1.1597, down 0.2% for the week.

As the euro weakened, the European Central Bank raised its main policy rate by 25 basis points on Thursday. The ECB said Middle‑East conflict‑driven energy price increases continue to exert price pressure.
In its statement, the ECB warned that the conflict is still “creating inflationary pressure,” and that inflation is expected to remain “significantly above the 2% target for a prolonged period.”
Additionally, Bloomberg reported on Thursday that sources said ECB officials anticipate further rate hikes, possibly as early as next month.

The dollar index stood at 99.0901, up 0.0063%; EUR/USD was at 1.1597, down 0.1034%; GBP/USD at 1.3526, up 0.1036%; AUD/USD at 0.7171, up 0.2096%; USD/CAD at 1.3869, up 0.2602%; USD/JPY at 153.5000, down 0.6151%.

items.title: 高價咖啡撐不住了？30萬袋巴西豆準備湧入ICE倉庫
items.title_en: High Coffee Prices Losing Steam? 300,000 Bags of Brazilian Beans Set to Flood ICE Warehouses
paras: 全球咖啡交易商正準備把大批巴西阿拉比卡咖啡運往洲際交易所(ICE-US)倉庫，可望使已降至26年低點的認證庫存增加逾一倍，並對目前仍處高檔的咖啡價格構成下行壓力。
ICE Futures U.S.阿拉比卡咖啡期貨是全球咖啡定價基準，價格7月一度升破每磅3.5美元，創6個月新高，目前仍徘徊在每磅3美元附近。儘管市場預期2026/27年度將出現大量供應過剩，價格卻遲遲未明顯回落，分析師認為，主因在於ICE認證庫存極度短缺。

約30萬袋巴西咖啡準備交割

目前ICE阿拉比卡咖啡認證庫存不到22萬袋，其中約七成存放於比利時安特衛普，遠低於2000年代中期至2022年初通常介於100萬至500萬袋的水準。交易所庫存被視為衡量可供交割剩餘咖啡數量的重要指標，對期貨價格具有顯著影響。
兩名消息人士透露，大型農產品交易商Olam正尋求讓15萬至20萬袋咖啡取得ICE認證，以趕上12月期貨合約交割；另一家大型交易商Louis Dreyfus Company(LDC)也在進行類似安排。兩家公司均拒絕置評。
業界預估，可能送交ICE的咖啡合計約30萬袋，足以讓現有認證庫存增加逾一倍。雖然庫存仍無法回到交易商認為較為充裕的100萬袋水準，但一家大型農產品交易商的消息人士表示，這批供應仍可能壓低價格。
庫存回升也可能觸發程式交易。許多演算法基金設定在交易所庫存增加時自動賣出咖啡期貨，庫存下降時則進場買入，因此新一波咖啡取得認證並入庫後，可能進一步放大價格跌勢。

輸往比利時暴增245%釋出供應訊號

交易商與分析師通常把巴西對比利時出口量異常增加，視為烘焙商需求獲得滿足後，剩餘供應正流向交易所的訊號。一名大型咖啡交易商分析師估計，巴西8月出口的阿拉比卡咖啡中，約15萬袋超出烘焙商的平均需求，很可能送往ICE倉庫，9月預計還有更多貨物抵達。
根據巴西政府數據及券商Terra Investimentos分析，巴西8月對比利時咖啡出口量年增245.3%，達3.15萬公噸，相當於逾52.5萬袋、每袋60公斤的咖啡。
ICE資料顯示，目前已有逾6.2萬袋巴西咖啡運抵交易所倉庫，正等待分級與品質檢驗，以取得可用於ICE 12月期貨合約交割的認證，但最終有多少能順利通過檢查仍不清楚。
ICE在一定程度上扮演咖啡市場的「最後買家」，為過剩供應提供去處，因此只要庫存開始回升，便可能吸引投資人押注價格下跌。隨著巴西咖啡陸續抵達，支撐咖啡價格的庫存短缺題材正面臨轉折。
paras_en: Global coffee traders are preparing to ship a large batch of Brazilian Arabica coffee to Intercontinental Exchange (ICE‑US) warehouses, which could more than double the certified stocks that have fallen to a 26‑year low and put downward pressure on currently high coffee prices.

ICE Futures U.S. Arabica coffee futures are the global benchmark, spiking above $3.50 per pound in July to a six‑month high and now hovering around $3 per pound. Even though the market expects a massive oversupply in the 2026/27 season, prices have been slow to fall, analysts say mainly because ICE‑certified inventories are extremely scarce.

About 300,000 bags of Brazilian coffee are ready for delivery. ICE’s Arabica certified inventory is now under 220,000 bags, roughly 70% of which sit in Antwerp, Belgium, far below the mid‑2000s to early‑2022 norm of 1‑5 million bags. Exchange inventories are viewed as a key gauge of deliverable coffee and have a strong impact on futures prices.

Two sources said large agribusiness trader Olam is seeking to have 150,000‑200,000 bags certified by ICE to meet the December futures delivery, while another major trader, Louis Dreyfus Company (LDC), is making similar arrangements. Both firms declined comment.

Industry estimates put the total coffee that could be sent to ICE at about 300,000 bags, enough to more than double the current certified stock. Although inventories would still fall short of the roughly 1 million bags that traders consider comfortable, a source at a large agribusiness firm said the influx could still push prices lower.

Rising inventories could also trigger algorithmic trading. Many systematic funds are programmed to sell coffee futures automatically when exchange stocks rise and to buy when they fall, so a new wave of certified coffee entering warehouses could amplify the price decline further.

Exports to Belgium surge 245% signalling supply flow. Traders and analysts often view an abnormal jump in Brazil’s shipments to Belgium as a signal that roaster demand has been met and excess supply is moving to the exchange. One senior coffee trader estimates that of Brazil’s August Arabica exports, about 150,000 bags exceed average roaster demand and are likely headed for ICE warehouses, with more cargo expected in September.

According to Brazilian government data and brokerage Terra Investimentos, Brazil’s August coffee exports to Belgium rose 245.3% year‑on‑year to 31,500 metric tons, equivalent to over 525,000 bags of 60 kg each.

ICE data show that more than 62,000 bags of Brazilian coffee have already arrived at exchange warehouses and are awaiting grading and quality checks to become eligible for the December futures delivery, though it remains unclear how many will ultimately pass inspection.

ICE acts to some extent as the coffee market’s “last buyer,” providing an outlet for surplus supply. Consequently, any rebound in inventories could attract investors betting on price declines. As Brazilian coffee continues to arrive, the shortage narrative that has supported prices is facing a turning point.

items.title: 日本央行升息提速至一季一次？市場擔憂套利交易退潮放大股債波動
items.title_en: Bank of Japan Accelerates Rate Hikes to Quarterly? Market Fears Arbitrage Fade Amplifies Equity and Bond Volatility
paras: 市場對日本央行貨幣政策正常化的預期顯著提速。多數訊息指出，日本央行於9月18日會議將政策利率由1%調升25個基點至1.25%已幾成定局，利率水準將創下31年來新高。
彭博最新調查顯示，受訪的52位經濟學家全數預期9月升息，且約93%認為最遲明年1月會再度升息；預估升息步調將加快至「每季一次」的比例顯著攀升至46%，遠高於先前主流的「每半年一次」。不過，本輪緊縮周期的終點利率預估中位數仍維持在1.75%。
驅動升息預期的主因在於國內外物價壓力持續累積。日本8月企業物價指數年增率達7.6%，加上國際局勢推升布蘭特原油價格重返每桶100美元以上，抵銷了日元升值帶來的進口降溫效果。
此外，外圍政治因素也受到矚目，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)多次發表支持升息言論，日本財務大臣片山皋月則回應，將與美方保持密切溝通，繼續維護外匯市場秩序。
市場擔憂，日本央行若加快升息節奏，對於「借入低息日元、轉而投資海外高收益資產」的日元套利交易來說，將顯著增加借入日元的融資成本，壓低套利交易的利差空間，進而削弱對海外風險資產的資金支持。
另一方面，若升息同時伴隨日元快速升值，投資人償還日元債務時將面臨匯兌損失，可能觸發追加保證金或迫使槓桿部位平倉，形成「日元升值與資產拋售」相互強化的負向反饋，放大全球股債市場的波動。
Totan Research Institute首席經濟學家加藤出表示，日本央行可能會向市場傳達升息間隔通常約為三個月的訊號，市場焦點將在於央行會以多大力度暗示未來進一步提高升息頻率。
岡三證券首席債券策略師長谷川直也認為，美方的表態主要是在向日本政府施壓，要求其切勿阻撓央行推進政策正常化。
法國巴黎銀行日本首席經濟學家河野龍太郎分析，若審議委員佐藤綾野與淺田統一郎投下贊成票，顯示政府要求維持寬鬆的阻力已顯著減弱。日本央行審議委員增一行指出，基礎通膨雖接近2%，但未見大幅超越，暗示目前尚無大幅升息50個基點的即時風險。
paras_en: Market expectations for the Bank of Japan's monetary policy normalisation have accelerated sharply. Most reports indicate that the BOJ’s September 18 meeting will raise the policy rate by 25 basis points from 1% to 1.25%, a move that is now largely a foregone conclusion and will set a 31‑year high for rates.

A Bloomberg poll of 52 economists shows all of them expect a September hike, and about 93% think another hike will occur by January next year at the latest; the share expecting the pace to quicken to “once per quarter” jumps to 46%, far above the previously mainstream “once every six months”. Yet the median estimate for the terminal rate of this tightening cycle remains at 1.75%.

The main driver of the hike expectations is the continued build‑up of price pressures at home and abroad. Japan’s corporate price index rose 7.6% year‑on‑year in August, and Brent crude has surged back above $100 a barrel due to international tensions, offsetting the cooling effect of a stronger yen on import prices.

External political factors are also in focus. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has repeatedly voiced support for rate hikes, and Japan’s Finance Minister Shun‑suke Katayama responded that Japan will keep close communication with the U.S. and continue to maintain order in the foreign‑exchange market.

The market worries that if the BOJ speeds up the pace of hikes, the classic yen‑carry trade—borrowing low‑cost yen to invest in higher‑yielding overseas assets—will see borrowing costs rise sharply, compressing the spread and weakening funding for overseas risk assets.

Conversely, if rate hikes are accompanied by a rapid yen appreciation, investors repaying yen‑denominated debt could suffer foreign‑exchange losses, potentially triggering margin calls or forced liquidation of leveraged positions, creating a negative feedback loop of “yen appreciation and asset sell‑offs” that could magnify global equity and bond market volatility.

Kato, chief economist at Totan Research Institute, said the BOJ may signal that the typical interval between hikes is about three months, and market attention will focus on how strongly the bank hints at further increasing the frequency of hikes.
Naoya Hasegawa, chief bond strategist at Oka Securities, believes the U.S. statements are mainly aimed at pressuring the Japanese government not to obstruct the BOJ’s policy normalisation.

Ryu‑taro Kono, chief economist for Japan at BNP Paribas, analysed that if board members Ayano Sato and Ichiro Asada vote in favour, it would show that resistance to maintaining easy policy has markedly weakened. A BOJ board member added that core inflation is close to 2% but has not surged far beyond, suggesting there is no immediate risk of a large 50‑basis‑point hike at present.

items.title: 〈台幣〉買匯避險升溫 爆量貶值9分收31.638元
items.title_en: TWD Hedging Demand Rises, Massive Volume, Depreciates 0.09 to Close at 31.638
paras: 在國際油價攀升、美國升息壓力升溫的衝擊下，台北股匯市重挫，買匯避險力道湧現，新台幣今(11)日全日處貶值態勢，最低一度逼近31.7元價位，終場收在31.638元，貶值9分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值暴出29.38億美元天量。
新台幣今日以31.58元、貶值3.2分開出後，越走越低，午盤後開出全日最低價31.698元，買匯力道相當強勁，收盤前一小時貶值壓力才緩步收斂，高低價差1.18角。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元反而強彈超過0.4%，日元升值0.2%，泰銖、人民幣和星元微幅升值，新台幣最弱勢，收貶0.29%。
元大投顧分析，美國8月PPI年增5.4%、月增0.4%，高於市場預期，也推高各界對美國升息的預期，同時，美國10年期公債殖利率向上逼近5%關卡，也加深市場避險情緒。
paras_en: Amid rising international oil prices and mounting pressure for U.S. rate hikes, Taipei's stock and foreign‑exchange markets suffered sharp declines, prompting a surge in demand for TWD hedging. The New Taiwan dollar was on a depreciation trend throughout the day, briefly approaching the 31.7 per dollar level, and ultimately closed at 31.638, down 0.09. Taipei forex brokers reported a record‑high turnover of USD 2.938 billion.

The TWD opened today at 31.58, down 0.032, and kept sliding lower, reaching a intraday low of 31.698 after the lunch break. Buying pressure was strong, and only in the final hour before the close did the depreciation pressure ease slightly, resulting in a high‑low spread of 0.118.

Looking at other major Asian currencies, the Korean won actually rallied more than 0.4%, the Japanese yen appreciated 0.2%, and the Thai baht, Chinese yuan, and Singapore dollar showed modest gains, while the TWD was the weakest, ending down 0.29%.

Yuanta Securities analysis notes that U.S. August PPI rose 5.4% year‑over‑year and 0.4% month‑over‑month, exceeding market expectations and fueling expectations of further U.S. rate hikes. At the same time, the yield on the 10‑year U.S. Treasury approached the 5% threshold, deepening market risk‑aversion.

items.title: BOJ下周傳升息1碼！基準利率衝1.25%創31年新高 恐釋加速緊縮訊號
items.title_en: BOJ Expected to Raise Rates by 1 Basis Point Next Week! Benchmark Rate Hits 1.25% – 31-Year High, Signaling Accelerated Tightening
paras: 路透引述四名知情人士說法報導，日本銀行(BOJ, 央行)可望在下周升息，最可能升息1碼(25個基點)，且若物價壓力升高、通膨超標風險加劇，日銀可能釋出未來加速緊縮的訊號。
若日銀真如此消息把升息至1.25%，基準利率將攀抵31年來最高水準。這也將代表日銀在6月升息只過三個月就再次升息，形同緊縮步調加快，特別是考量到日銀可能釋出年底前再次升息的訊號。
許多日銀官員認為，再次升息的條件正逐步成熟，國內經濟有望溫和復甦，物價壓力也正在升高。知情人士則透露，即使日銀升息至1.25%，金融環境預料仍將保持寬鬆。
他們指出，日元近期回升之後，可能在抑制進口成本漲幅的情況下，緩解物價壓力，但日元前一段時間已經大幅貶值，加上燃料價格恢復上漲，仍將使日銀對通膨風險保持警戒。
日銀在6月將利率升至1%，並承諾若經濟與物價發展符合基礎預測情境，將進一步推高借貸升息。
日銀在7月會議上維持利率不變，但警告中東衝突、日元疲弱以及強勁的人工智慧(AI)相關需求正在加劇物價壓力，可能造成通膨超標風險，讓外界解讀近期升息可能性很高。
路透調查的分析師預期，日銀將在9月17日至18日的會議上升息至1.25%，明年3月底前升至1.5%，接著在2027年第2季升至1.75%。多數分析師認為，終端利率至少為1.75%。
9月之後，日銀將於10月、12月以及明年1月召開決策會議。
由於市場已完全反映9月升息預期，部分市場人士大膽押注日銀可能意外升息2碼(50個基點)，以帶來更大的驚喜。但由於目前沒有薪資與物價成長突然加速的迫切風險，知情人士表示，日銀下周可能仍會選擇常見的升息1碼，並等待更多數據，以判斷是否有必要再次升息。
日銀理事增一行(Kazuyuki Masu)周四表示，「核心通膨即將達到2%，但我們看不到大幅超過這一水準的情況」，這番話顯示他認為目前沒有通膨即將急遽飆升的跡象，因此下周沒有必要大幅升息。

終端利率沒有預設值

市場正關注日銀總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)會後記者會的訊號，包括未來升息步調，以及日銀在本輪緊縮周期中利率可能升至多高。
知情人士表示，日銀可能沒有預設的終端利率，最終水準將取決於過去升息對經濟的影響，以及企業把成本上升轉嫁給家庭的程度。
日銀內部對升息速度也沒有共識，鷹派認為核心通膨已達2%，但也有反對6月升息的鴿派人士存在。
因此，知情人士表示，植田和男將避免給出有關未來升息的具體時間表，但可能重申7月的說法，也就是認為在金融環境過於寬鬆的情況下，日銀可能加快升息步調。
自7月底美日聯手干預匯市以來，日元已升值逾6%，儘管日元升值原本預料能引導進口成本下降的效果，但布蘭特原油本周重返每桶100美元之上，抵銷了日元升值帶來的效應，也讓人擔憂通膨壓力重新升高。
paras_en: Reuters quoted four insiders saying the Bank of Japan (BOJ, the central bank) is likely to raise rates next week, most probably by 1 basis point (25 basis points), and if inflationary pressures rise and the risk of inflation exceeding targets increases, the BOJ may signal a future acceleration of tightening.

If the BOJ indeed raises rates to 1.25%, the benchmark rate would reach its highest level in 31 years. This would also mean the BOJ would raise rates again just three months after the June hike, effectively speeding up the tightening pace, especially considering the possibility of another rate hike before year‑end.

Many BOJ officials believe the conditions for a second hike are gradually maturing, the domestic economy is expected to recover moderately, and price pressures are rising. Insiders say that even if the BOJ raises rates to 1.25%, the financial environment is expected to remain accommodative.

They pointed out that after the yen recently appreciated, it may help curb import cost increases and ease price pressures, but the yen had previously depreciated sharply, and with fuel prices rebounding, the BOJ will remain vigilant about inflation risks.
The BOJ raised rates to 1% in June and pledged to further lift borrowing costs if the economy and price developments align with its baseline forecast.

At the July meeting, the BOJ kept rates unchanged but warned that the Middle East conflict, a weak yen, and strong AI‑related demand are intensifying price pressures, potentially raising the risk of inflation exceeding targets, leading observers to interpret a high likelihood of a recent rate hike.

Analysts surveyed by Reuters expect the BOJ to raise rates to 1.25% at the September 17‑18 meeting, to 1.5% by the end of March next year, and then to 1.75% in Q2 2027. Most analysts believe the terminal rate will be at least 1.75%.
After September, the BOJ will hold decision meetings in October, December, and January next year.

Because the market has fully priced in the September hike, some market participants boldly bet that the BOJ might unexpectedly raise rates by 2 basis points (50 basis points) for a bigger surprise. However, since there is no urgent risk of sudden wage and price growth acceleration, insiders say the BOJ may still choose the usual 1‑basis‑point hike next week and wait for more data to decide whether another hike is necessary.

BOJ board member Kazuyuki Masu said on Thursday, "Core inflation is about to reach 2%, but we do not see a large overshoot of this level," indicating he sees no signs of a sudden inflation surge, so a large hike next week is unnecessary.
The market is watching the signals from BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda at the post‑meeting press conference, including the pace of future hikes and how high rates could rise in this tightening cycle.
Insiders say the BOJ may not have a preset terminal rate; the final level will depend on the impact of past hikes on the economy and how much firms pass cost increases onto households.
There is no consensus within the BOJ on the pace of hikes; hawks believe core inflation has reached 2%, but there are also dovish voices who opposed the June hike.

Therefore, insiders say Ueda will avoid giving a specific timetable for future hikes but may reiterate July’s stance, namely that in an overly accommodative financial environment the BOJ could accelerate the pace of hikes.

Since the joint US‑Japan intervention in the FX market at the end of July, the yen has appreciated over 6%. Although the yen’s appreciation was expected to lower import costs, Brent crude returned above $100 a barrel this week, offsetting the effect of the yen’s appreciation and raising concerns that inflationary pressure may rise again.

items.title: 日元近期強升非短線反彈？ 知名資管機構：低估修正啟動 回調即布局多頭
items.title_en: Yen's Recent Surge Not a Short-Term Bounce? Prominent Asset Management Firm: Undervaluation Correction Begins, Pullbacks Offer Bullish Positioning
paras: 日元近期強勢攀升，可能並非短期反彈，而是多年低估狀態進入更廣泛修正。歐洲資產管理公司Edmond de Rothschild多資產及對沖策略主管Michael Nizard最新表示，日元正擺脫長期由美日利差與套利交易主導的定價模式，重新回歸基本面。
Nizard說，「日元可能正在重新成為真正由基本面驅動的貨幣」，並稱未來回檔應視為重建，或是加碼日元多頭的機會。
本月以來日元已升值逾3%。日本央行(BOJ)加快緊縮的預期升溫，加上日本退休金資金配置可能改變，投資人紛紛平倉日元空單。美國財長貝森特此前更向交易員喊話「敢做空日元試試看」。
Nizard認為，近期美日聯合干預匯市同樣關鍵，市場原以為東京當局容忍日元貶值，聯合干預扭轉了預期，使日元貶值從「單向交易」變成漲跌風險並存的「雙向交易」。若日元續強，套利交易恐進一步平倉，槓桿下降將引發投資人拋售美債、信用債與股票；日本資金若回流國內，也將為全球債市帶來新波動。
他並提醒，修正過程不會是單方向，期間仍可能盤整甚至回弱，但只要趨勢不變，回檔都是布局多頭的機會。
基本面也出現改善。根據BOJ今(11)日公布的數據，8月企業商品價格指數(CGPI)年增7.6%，高於預期的7.4%，略低於7月修正後的7.7%，但月減0.2%。數據顯示，日企仍面臨能源、運輸、包裝與工資成本壓力，最終可能轉嫁消費者，推升通膨風險。
目前，市場普遍預估BOJ下周五(18日)將升息1碼至1.25%。
paras_en: The yen's recent strong climb may not be a short‑term rebound but rather a broader correction as it moves out of years of undervaluation. Michael Nizard, head of multi‑asset and hedge‑fund strategies at European asset manager Edmond de Rothschild, said the yen is shedding the pricing model long dominated by US‑Japan interest‑rate differentials and arbitrage trades, and is returning to fundamentals.

Nizard said, “The yen may be becoming a currency truly driven by fundamentals,” and added that any future pull‑back should be seen as a rebuilding phase, or an opportunity to add to long yen positions.

Since the start of the month the yen has appreciated by more than 3%. Expectations that the Bank of Japan will tighten faster are heating up, and possible changes in Japanese pension fund allocations are prompting investors to unwind short yen positions. U.S. Treasury Secretary Yellen earlier urged traders, “If you dare to short the yen, give it a try.”

Nizard sees the recent joint US‑Japan intervention in the FX market as equally pivotal. The market had assumed Tokyo tolerated yen depreciation; the coordinated intervention flipped that expectation, turning yen weakness from a one‑way trade into a two‑way trade with both upside and downside risk. If the yen keeps strengthening, arbitrage positions are likely to be further unwound, reduced leverage could trigger investors to sell U.S. Treasuries, credit bonds and equities; a repatriation of Japanese capital would also introduce new volatility to global bond markets.

He cautioned that the correction will not be unidirectional; there may be periods of consolidation or even temporary weakness, but as long as the trend remains intact, each pull‑back is an opportunity to build long positions.

Fundamentals are also improving. According to data released by the BOJ today (Nov 11), the August corporate goods price index (CGPI) rose 7.6% year‑on‑year, above the 7.4% forecast, slightly below the revised July figure of 7.7%, and fell 0.2% month‑on‑month. The data show Japanese firms still face pressure from energy, transport, packaging and wage costs, which could eventually be passed on to consumers, raising inflation risks.
Currently the market broadly expects the BOJ to raise rates by one basis point to 1.25% on Friday, the 18th.
